jobs.title: Relocation Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Cumming Group, you will work on some of the world's most exciting projects in a dynamic environment where your success is measured by the impact you make. We are one of the fastest-growing project and cost management consultancies in the United States, as reflected in our top 15 rankings in ENR. With over 70 offices globally, an extremely diverse project portfolio, and double-digit year-over-year revenue growth, the opportunities to make your mark are limitless!

  
  
  

We are currently hiring a Relocation Project Coordinator to work within our Education project sector in Los Angeles, CA. This role supports the relocation project team within a large community college school district and will support all FF&E activities and move management activities for multiple college campuses in the greater Los Angeles area.

  
  

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Support the Furniture/Equipment/Relocation Project Management Services with emphasis in FF&E selection, procurement coordination and purchasing for all such areas as identified by the school district to provide the onsite FF&E and move-in/relocations management services. Responsibilities include strategic oversight of all FF&E procurement, FF&E Installation, Pre-move, Move, and Post move/Close-out phase activities for specified assigned projects. Services shall be provided at the direction of the College Project Director (CPD) and the Manager of Relocation Project Management team.
* Assist with the procurement and purchasing of FF&E using best-value and/or low bid public contracting.
* Support budget and schedule tracking efforts for FF&E and moves, and meet with relevant Project Architects (A/E), and Project Managers to be able to prepare office layouts and work with the occupants to plan furniture and equipment relocation of existing to the move location. Work with vendors and/or movers to assist with filling in equipment and furnishings where there are gaps.
* Coordinate and prepare a list of all new furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist with the timely and successful onsite FF&E installation, punch-list sign-off and transition during swing space, relocation and/or move into new buildings.
* Support the procurement of specialty contractors or Movers for installations, delivery, and/or connections not covered by the FF&E vendors. Create detailed scope of work for Task Orders for Contractors/Movers as necessary.
* Support the Relocation PM in working with the Project Interior Designer and the building user groups to select and prepare a list of all furniture and equipment needed for the project.
* Assist in the onsite unlocking of all areas requiring access by the movers and others during the Pre-Move, Move, Installation and Post Move/Close-Out Phases and for the re-securing all such areas.
* Assist in the onsite coordination of all furniture and equipment deliveries with PMs, CPDs, Facility Directors, and BUGs if applicable; work closely with Asset Management Team to coordinate all asset tagging and disposition requirements, and Warranty Program Managers and other members of program staff working towards close-out of projects.
* Maintain all FF&E, move management, moving and storage related documents, including proposals, purchase orders, packing slips, time cards, shipping documents, freight bills, and invoices.
  

  

**Knowledge & Skills Required:**

* Ability to provide update and status reports for work in progress including cost and schedules.
* Experience with set-up and document control.
* Ability to read architectural and furniture drawing.
* Knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD software.
* Strong written and oral communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to be onsite at multiple project sites. Flexibility in schedule and transportation to work at multiple locations based on assigned schedule.
  

  
  

**Preferred Education and Experience:**

* High School diploma required. Bachelor degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Interior Architecture, Construction Management, Facilities Management, or related field is preferred.
* A minimum of one (1) year of related experience in Interior Design, Construction, Engineering, Moves/Relocations, Facilities, or Furniture, Fixture and Equipment coordination/procurement.
* Procurement, sourcing, or asset management experience is preferred.
* Public works experience in preferred.
* Certification/Membership with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, and LEED is preferred.
  

  

*Cumming Group is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunity in its personnel policies and practices. It is Cumming Group’s policy to recruit, hire, train and promote Team Members and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex, marital status, registered domestic partner status, genetic information, sexual preference, sexual orientation, gender (including gender expression and gender identity), pregnancy (including childbirth or related medical conditions, including breastfeeding), military service, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical disability, mental disability, veteran status or any other protected classification under federal, state, or local law. All such decisions are based on (1) individual merit, qualifications, and competence as they relate to the particular position, and (2) promotion of the principle of equal employment opportunity.*

*All other terms and conditions of employment, such as compensation, benefits, transfers, layoff, return from layoff, training, education, and social and recreational programs, are administered without regard to the characteristics described above. To this end, Cumming Group complies with all provisions of Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 as amended, all of the rules, regulations and relevant orders of the Secretary of Labor, and all similar state and local laws.*

jobs.title: Asset/Move Coordinator I (Relocation Project Coordinator)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Join Our Team**

Project Support Services (PSS) is seeking an organized, detail-oriented Asset/Move Coordinator I to support the Los Angeles Community College District’s BuildLACCD program. This position assists with furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FF&E) coordination and campus relocations for new buildings, renovated facilities, and temporary swing spaces.

The ideal candidate brings experience in relocation coordination, interior design, construction, facilities, or FF&E procurement and enjoys coordinating the details that help campus teams move into functional, ready-to-use spaces.

**Position Overview**

Working with the Relocation Project Management (RPM) team, the Asset/Move Coordinator I supports FF&E planning, procurement, budget and schedule tracking, deliveries, installation, and move coordination across multiple LACCD campuses.

Under the direction of the College Project Director and RPM leadership, this position coordinates with campus representatives, project teams, designers, vendors, and movers throughout pre-move planning, installation, relocation, and closeout.

Assignments may include campuses within the Valleyside group—Los Angeles Valley College, Los Angeles Mission College, and Los Angeles Pierce College—and/or the Cityside group—Los Angeles City College, Los Angeles Trade-Technical College, and East Los Angeles College/South Gate. The position requires onsite availability, reliable transportation between assigned locations, and schedule flexibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support FF&E selection, programming, specifications, procurement coordination, purchasing, and installation for new, renovated, and swing space projects.
* Assist with FF&E purchasing through best-value and/or low-bid public contracting processes.
* Coordinate with architects, interior designers, Project Managers, and campus user groups to identify furniture and equipment requirements.
* Assist with office layouts and plans for relocating existing furniture and equipment to new spaces.
* Prepare and maintain lists of new furniture and equipment needed for assigned projects, identifying gaps and coordinating with vendors or movers.
* Track FF&E and relocation budgets, schedules, purchases, deliveries, and installation activities.
* Support move planning, including scope development, bidding, bid analysis, scheduling, and onsite coordination.
* Prepare detailed scopes of work for task orders involving movers and specialty contractors supporting delivery, installation, or equipment connections.
* Coordinate furniture and equipment deliveries with project teams, campus facilities personnel, and building occupants.
* Assist with onsite FF&E installation, move oversight, punch list completion, and transition into occupied spaces.
* Coordinate access to project areas during pre-move, installation, move, and closeout activities, including unlocking and securing spaces as needed.
* Work with the Asset Management Team to coordinate asset tagging and disposition requirements.
* Coordinate with warranty personnel and other program staff to support project closeout.
* Maintain organized FF&E, moving, and storage records, including proposals, purchase orders, packing slips, time cards, shipping documents, freight bills, and invoices.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* At least one year of related experience in interior design, construction, engineering, moves/relocations, facilities, or FF&E coordination/procurement.
* High school diploma.
* Ability to read architectural and furniture drawings.
* Knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement.
* Strong written and verbal communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and related word processing, spreadsheet, and database software.
* Ability to work onsite at multiple colleges.
* Schedule flexibility and transportation to work at multiple locations based on project assignments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Four-year degree in Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Construction/Project Management, Facilities Management, or a related field.
* Experience in procurement, sourcing, or asset management.
* Public works experience.
* Knowledge of or proficiency in AutoCAD.
* Relevant certification or professional membership associated with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, or LEED.

**Apply**

Submit your resume highlighting your experience in FF&E coordination, procurement, facilities, or relocation projects, including any experience supporting educational facilities or public works programs.

Pay: $82,000.00 - $93,500.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 1 year of related experience in Interior Design, Construction, Engineering, Moves/Relocations, Facilities, or Furniture, Fixture and Equipment coordination/procurement?
* Do you have a high school diploma?
* Do you have knowledge of furniture and equipment specifications and procurement, as well as the ability to read architectural and furniture drawings?
* Do you have public works experience?
* Do you have procurement, sourcing or asset management experience?
* Do you have certification/membership with CID, IIDA, AIA, IFMA, LEED?
* Do you have proficiency in Microsoft Office and related word processing, spreadsheet, and database software?
* Do you have a four-year degree in the areas of Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Construction/Project Management, Facilities Management or related area required?

Ability to Commute:

* Los Angeles, CA 90017 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Overview:

MemorialCare is a nonprofit integrated health system that includes four leading hospitals, award-winning medical groups – consisting of over 200 sites of care, and more than 2,000 physicians throughout Orange and Los Angeles Counties. We are committed to increasing access to patient-centric, affordable, and high-quality healthcare; your personal contributions are integral to MemorialCare's recognition as a market leader and innovator in value-based and other care models.

Across our family of medical centers, we support each one of our bright, talented employees in reaching the highest levels of professional development, contribution, collaboration, and accountability. Whatever your role and whatever expertise you bring, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential in an environment of respect, innovation, and teamwork.

Responsibilities:

**Title:** RN Coordinator, Clinical Program - Women's and Newborn Services

**Location:** Long Beach, CA

**Department:** Nursing Administration

**Status:** Full-Time (FT)

**Shift:** Days

**Pay Range:** $62.52/hr - $90.63/hr

MemorialCare is a nonprofit integrated health system that includes four leading hospitals, award-winning medical groups – consisting of over 200 sites of care, and more than 2,000 physicians throughout Orange and Los Angeles Counties. We are committed to increasing access to patient-centric, affordable, and high-quality healthcare; your personal contributions are integral to MemorialCare's recognition as a market leader and innovator in value-based and other care models.

Across our family of medical centers, we support each one of our bright, talented employees in reaching the highest levels of professional development, contribution, collaboration, and accountability. Whatever your role and whatever expertise you bring, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential in an environment of respect, innovation, and teamwork.

**Position Summary**

The Clinical Program Coordinator is responsible for the coordination, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of clinical programs, quality initiatives, and strategic projects across the Birth Care Center. This position serves as a key resource to operational and physician leaders, providing expertise in performance improvement, program development, data analysis, clinical systems optimization, and multidisciplinary project management. The Clinical Program Coordinator facilitates collaboration among clinical, operational, and medical staff to support safe, high-quality patient care, achieve organizational goals, improve clinical outcomes, and ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation requirements. The role provides oversight and coordination of assigned clinical programs, supports implementation of service line priorities, and serves as a subject matter expert for quality, safety, performance improvement, and operational excellence initiatives.

**Clinical Program Coordination**  
  
Outcome: Ensures effective coordination and oversight of assigned maternal and newborn clinical programs.  
  
Functions:  
  
Coordinates designated Birth Care Center programs including newborn screening, newborn hearing screening, CCHD screening, HUGS infant security, and other assigned initiatives.  
Serves as a liaison among clinical staff, physicians, ancillary departments, and external agencies.  
Supports program implementation, monitoring, education, and compliance activities.  
Coordinates required audits, reporting, and follow-up activitie

  

**Physician Partnership & Committee Support**  
  
Outcome: Supports physician engagement and interdisciplinary collaboration to advance Birth Care Center priorities.  
  
Functions:  
  
Coordinates Perinatal Morbidity & Mortality conferences and related follow-up activities.  
Represents the Women's Service Line at physician-led committees, workgroups, and service-line meetings.  
Assists with communication, documentation, and implementation of committee recommendations.  
Serves as a resource to physician and operational leaders on assigned programs and projects.

  

**Infant Security Program Coordination (HUGS)**  
  
Outcome: Supports effective administration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of the HUGS Infant Security Program.  
  
Functions:  
  
Serves as the Birth Care Center liaison for the HUGS Infant Security Program.  
Coordinates planned and unplanned HUGS system downtime activities in collaboration with Information Technology, Security, Clinical Engineering, and clinical operations teams.  
Facilitates communication and implementation of downtime and contingency plans to maintain patient safety during system interruptions.  
Monitors infant security events and maintains program records.  
Compiles, analyzes, and presents infant security event data, trends, and compliance metrics to department leadership and committees on a quarterly basis.  
Coordinates follow-up activities and process improvement efforts related to infant security events.

The Key Account Manager (KAM) is a field-based commercial leader responsible for driving the successful adoption, demand generation, and market access of Henlius US oncology biosimilar products across Community Oncology Practices, Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), Academic Medical Centers, and Key Cancer Centers.

Reporting to the Regional Business Director, the Key Account Manager will operate in a highly collaborative, startup environment, serving as the primary customer-facing representative responsible for developing strategic account partnerships, identifying growth opportunities, influencing key stakeholders, and executing business plans that maximize patient access and commercial performance.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a deep understanding of oncology treatment pathways, biosimilar market dynamics, buy-and-bill economics, GPO contracting, and complex healthcare decision-making structures. This individual will build trusted relationships with clinicians, practice administrators, pharmacy leadership, and health system decision-makers while working cross-functionally to achieve business objectives.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Strategic Account Management**

* Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account business plans aligned with organizational objectives and market opportunities.
* Establish, cultivate, and expand strategic relationships within community oncology practices, IDNs, academic institutions, and major cancer centers.
* Identify and influence key stakeholders involved in clinical, operational, financial, and pharmacy decision-making processes.
* Create account-specific growth strategies that accelerate biosimilar adoption, utilization, and pull-through within targeted accounts.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key oncology providers, administrators, infusion leaders, pharmacists, and executive decision-makers.

### **Market Access & Contract Optimization**

* Drive awareness, utilization, and pull-through of contracted business across GPOs, IDNs, and health system networks.
* Partner with customers to optimize product access and address barriers related to formulary placement, procurement, reimbursement, inventory management, and operational workflows.
* Collaborate with Market Access and Contracting teams to ensure customers understand the economic and clinical value proposition of Fosun Henlius products.
* Support account adoption strategies by identifying opportunities to improve access and operational efficiencies.

### **Customer Engagement & Clinical Business Leadership**

* Serve as the trusted business partner for customers by delivering customer-centric solutions that enhance patient access and support quality oncology care.
* Conduct high-impact customer interactions, including individual engagements, account reviews and business presentations.
* Demonstrate strong account-based selling capabilities through tailored engagement strategies across multiple customer segments.
* Leverage data analytics, market intelligence, customer insights, and territory performance metrics to prioritize opportunities and inform strategic decisions.
* Maintain a deep understanding of oncology treatment landscapes, biosimilar trends, competitive products, reimbursement dynamics, and evolving healthcare policies.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**

  
  

ADT has been in the business of helping save lives since 1874. As the #1 smart home security provider in the U.S., we help protect and connect families, businesses and larger commercial customer every day. Our continuous innovation, advanced technology and strategic partnerships deliver products and services that help protect life and valuables, whether at home, your business or on the go. And as times change, so do we.Above all, our mission is clear: we help save lives for a living. Looking for a career where you can make a real impact? Join our team today and put purpose behind your paycheck. #WeAreADT

*Check out more about life at ADT* here.

**What you should know about our team:**

At ADT, our Sales team is at the heart of everything we do. We’re not just selling security systems, we’re helping protect what matters most. Whether it’s a family home or a small business, our sales professionals are trusted advisors who bring peace of mind to customers across the country.

**What you will do:**

You’ll use your strong communication and creative skills to demonstrate the value of our innovative security and smart home solutions to customers while explaining our products and services in-depth and recommending the right solutions. You will work in a dynamic, collaborative environment, working closely with customers and coworkers. This role involves providing solutions by visiting customers at their homes. You will:

* Listen and build trust: By showing up with integrity, empathy, and expertise, you will become a reliable advisor customers can count on, both during the sale and long after the installation.
* Customize each system to fit your client’s space, lifestyle, and concerns, combining security, automation, and life safety technology in ways that work for them.
* Conduct post-installation follow-ups with customers to confirm that commitments were fulfilled and to generate referrals.
* Cultivate new business opportunities: identify and generate new sales leads to maximize outreach.

**What you need to be successful:**

We’re looking for self-motivated, tech-savvy individuals who are passionate about helping others and driven to succeed. If you thrive on connection, enjoy solving problems, and want to make a real impact while growing your career, you’ll fit right in.

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Willing to travel within a designated territory using your own vehicle (mileage reimbursed).
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record required; additional licensing may be needed based on location.
* Comfortable using technology to stay organized, efficient, and accountable in a fast-paced sales environment.
* Self-motivated and results-driven, with an entrepreneurial mindset; you thrive on uncovering new leads and closing deals that deliver real value.
* Strong communicator and natural relationship builder, able to consult with customers, understand their needs, and guide them to the right solution.
* Adaptable and flexible; you excel in dynamic environments and enjoy learning new systems and approaches.
* Consumer sales experience is preferred but not required.

**How ADT invests in you:**

**Compensation:** Unlimited earning potential with uncapped commissions. Based upon performance, new sales advisors can expect to earn $95,000, while experienced sales advisors can earn over $150,000.

**Additional Pay:** We equip you with specialized training and the tools you need to meet your financial goals. For your first 8 weeks of training, you’ll earn up to $4,000.

**Benefits:**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Mileage reimbursement
* Short- and long-term disability, life insurance, and well-being programs
* Paid time off
* Culture of professional development and career growth opportunities
* Flexible work schedule to accommodate you and your customers’ needs
* Click here to view our full benefit offerings

**Why you’ll love working here:**

* We **boldly shape the future**, embracing change, taking smart risks, and continuously improving to create the best experiences.
* We **lead by taking ownership**, empowering you to make decisions, solve problems proactively, and support each other with empathy.
* We **elevate to serve a greater purpose**, going above and beyond to earn trust, celebrate wins, and value every perspective.
* We **unite and win together**, fostering teamwork, breaking down silos, and achieving shared goals through inclusivity and collaboration.

**Job Type:** Full-Time, On-site (No Remote Work)  
**Compensation:** Base Salary + Sales Commission

About Us

Uno Mega Textile Inc. is a fabric wholesale company serving customers in the apparel, textile, and related industries.

We are seeking a motivated, outgoing, and results-driven Sales Representative to join our team in Orange County, California.

Our ideal candidate enjoys prospecting, cold calling, meeting new customers, and building long-term business relationships.

**We believe successful salespeople should have the opportunity to write their own paycheck!**

Key Responsibilities

* Actively prospect and develop new B2B customers through cold calling, research, referrals, and other sales activities.
* Make outbound sales calls regularly to introduce our fabrics, identify opportunities, and schedule appointments.
* Identify potential customers, including apparel manufacturers, clothing brands, fabric buyers, and other textile-related businesses.
* Visit local customers approximately **1–2 times per week** to present fabric samples and develop business relationships.
* Attend approximately **2 industry trade shows per year** to generate new business opportunities.
* Participate in approximately **2 out-of-town business development trips annually**, which may involve driving or air travel depending on the destination.
* Prepare quotations, follow up on samples, negotiate sales opportunities, and convert leads into purchase orders.
* Maintain relationships with customers and encourage repeat business.
* Track sales activities, customer communications, and new business opportunities.

Qualifications

* Previous B2B sales or business development experience preferred.
* Experience in fabrics, textiles, apparel manufacturing, garment production, or related industries is a strong plus.
* **Willingness and ability to make cold calls and actively pursue new customers are essential.**
* Proven ability to develop new business and close sales.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
* Self-motivated, organized, persistent, and goal-oriented.
* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with an office-based team.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel for customer visits, trade shows, and occasional out-of-town business trips, including travel by car or airplane.

**Industry experience in fabrics, textiles, apparel manufacturing, or related fields is required.** We highly value candidates with strong business development skills and a proven track record of successfully acquiring new customers.

Work Schedule & Location

* Full-time, Monday through Friday
* Primarily office-based in Orange County, California
* No remote work
* Local customer visits approximately 1–2 times per week
* Approximately 2 industry trade shows annually
* Approximately 2 out-of-town business development trips annually, with transportation depending on the destination

Compensation & Benefits

* Base salary plus high **sales commission**
* Uncapped commission earning potential
* Opportunities to earn ongoing commissions on qualifying repeat customer orders while employed, subject to the written commission agreement
* Mileage reimbursement for authorized business travel in accordance with company policy and applicable law
* Reimbursement of authorized business travel expenses in accordance with company policy and applicable law
* Opportunity to build and grow your own customer base

**Your effort drives your success. The more business you develop, the greater your earning potential!**

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and briefly tell us:

* What experience do you have in the fabric, textile, apparel manufacturing, or related industries?
* What is your experience with cold calling and independently developing new B2B customers?
* How many new customers have you personally acquired in the past 12 months, and what sales results did you achieve?

**Location:** Preferred on-site in Orange County, CA (Santa Ana office). We're also open to hybrid or remote candidates working on Pacific Time (PT).  
**Type:** Full-Time  
**Salary:** $75,000 – $90,000 base, depending on experience

### **About eJam**

eJam is a privately held consumer products company that has built, scaled, and exited multiple brands. Our portfolio includes category leaders ranked at the top of Amazon, carried in major retailers nationwide, and sold across DTC, marketplaces, and every channel in between.

We’re not a startup hoping something works. We’re a team that has done it repeatedly: taken products from idea to category leader, landed them on retail shelves nationwide, and built real brands that consumers love. We operate like a holding company with the speed of a startup: small teams with real ownership and accountability.

This is the place where you’ll see the entire machine: sourcing, product development, packaging, manufacturing, compliance, marketing, marketplace strategy, retail, all under one roof. If you want to build and ship consumer products at scale, there is no better place than this.

### **The Role**

You will own the path from a customer order to recognized, reconciled revenue across every eJam channel, end to end. Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, QVC and retail each report revenue, refunds, fees and payouts differently, and you make them agree: one gross to net waterfall per brand, one daily revenue number the CEO, finance and media buyers all trust, and channel payouts that tie to the bank.

You will be the person who finds where the cash went missing, and the one who brings receivables management in house as we retire our outsourced A/R partner.

**Mission:** Finance and brand leadership know what we actually earned yesterday, by brand and channel, and every dollar between gross sales and the bank is explained, before they have to ask.

### **What You'll Own**

**Revenue data and reporting**

* Own the daily gross to net revenue report by brand and channel: gross sales, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, merchant and agency fees, sales tax and net revenue, and explain every movement
* Maintain the revenue layer of the BigQuery finance and goal pacing dashboards so the numbers the business runs on match what Accounting books
* Build and automate recurring revenue, subscription and channel performance reports, and replace manual spreadsheet pulls with repeatable queries
* Track subscription revenue health: rebill approval rates, declines, retries, churn and refund drivers, and flag what needs action

**Reconciliation and receivables**

* Reconcile Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop and payment processor payouts and settlements to the bank and the ledger each period, and chase every unexplained difference to its source
* Support the month end close with revenue, refund, chargeback and fee reconciliations, and the related journal entry support
* Manage retail and marketplace receivables (QVC, Target, Walmart, Kroger and the SAI portfolio as it moves in house): invoicing, remittance matching, deductions and short pays, and an aging the team acts on
* Own the sales tax data flow and marketplace facilitator treatment with our tax platform

**Process and systems**

* The order to cash process documented per channel, with control points and SOPs the team runs on, built with the data, subscription, customer support and media teams
* Recurring revenue reporting automated with Claude and documented so it survives a vacation

### **What Success Looks Like**

* **30 days:** the daily gross to net report publishes by brand without manual intervention and every channel's payout reconciliation is documented
* **90 days:** BigQuery revenue ties to QuickBooks Online for the prior month with a written bridge for every known difference, and retail and marketplace receivables aging is owned end to end
* **6 months:** order to cash SOPs exist for every channel, unreconciled revenue differences sit at zero at close, two recurring reports run materially faster, and the business trusts one revenue number

  
**Requirements**

**Required (all four, no exceptions)**

* **Order to cash:** tied Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Stripe or similar settlements and payouts back to the general ledger and found a gap
* **Gross to net:** built a bridge from gross sales through discounts, refunds, chargebacks, fees and tax to net revenue, and explained what moved
* **Subscription:** worked rebill approval, decline, retry and churn data for a recurring revenue business
* **Receivables:** managed retail or marketplace A/R, including remittance matching, deductions and short pays, with an aging someone acted on

**Also required**

* 3 to 7 years in revenue operations, revenue accounting or finance operations, ideally at a DTC, subscription or ecommerce brand
* Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, Power Query) and working SQL, BigQuery or another warehouse preferred, with dashboards in Looker Studio, Tableau or Power BI
* You use AI, primarily Claude, as a working tool every day, and you check its output before it goes anywhere
* Bachelor's in finance, accounting, economics, analytics or related

**Nice to have**

* QuickBooks Online or Ramp
* A subscription or order management stack
* Sales tax and marketplace facilitator mechanics (TaxJar, Numeral or Avalara)
* Amazon settlement reporting

  
**Benefits**

$75,000 to $90,000 base, depending on experience.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

SunClean is a growing commercial contract cleaning company serving high-end hotels, luxury multifamily developments, and aerospace facilities. Our work spans the life of a property. We help general contractors prepare new buildings for turnover, and we help property teams care for their windows, façades, floors, and other specialty surfaces once those buildings are in use.

As we expand into Arizona, Nevada, Texas, and Florida, we’re hiring **two Business Development Representatives**. Your focus will be finding and qualifying leads so our Business Development Managers know which opportunities to pursue, who to speak with, and why the timing makes sense.

What You’ll Do

**Specialty cleaning business development.** Connect with hotel general managers, chief engineers, property managers, and facilities teams. Learn how they maintain their properties, which services they outsource, and what work is coming up. A hotel may already have a vendor for its lobby glass and still need help with upper-floor windows, façade cleaning, pressure washing, or carpet and tile cleaning. Your job is to ask the questions that uncover that need.

**Construction business development.** A substantial part of your day will involve researching upcoming and active construction projects and making outbound calls to general contractors, developers, estimators, and project managers. You’ll use project listings, permit records, company websites, etc., to identify promising leads. Through those calls, you’ll confirm what cleaning services the project needs, when the work goes out to bid, and who manages the bid list. You’ll pass qualified leads to our Business Development Managers with the right contact, relevant project details, and bid deadlines.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

* Dedicate a substantial part of each day to prospect research. Review property portfolios, company websites, project listings, and permit records to identify leads for specialty and construction cleaning.
* Make outbound calls and write targeted emails to introduce SunClean, reach the right decision-maker, and learn what work is coming up. Use LinkedIn, networking, and in-person canvassing to develop additional contacts.
* Qualify leads by confirming the service needed, the project timeline, who selects vendors, and any bid requirements or deadlines.
* Manage your lead pipeline in HubSpot. Keep contact details and lead stages current, log calls and emails, and schedule follow-ups around bid dates and vendor reviews.
* Hand qualified leads to Business Development Managers with the details they need to act: who to contact, what the prospect needs, and when to follow up.

What You’ll Bring

You’re comfortable making the first call or introducing yourself in person. You listen closely, ask thoughtful questions, and stay organized enough to follow up at the right time. You enjoy working toward measurable goals and take initiative when you see an opportunity worth pursuing.

**No prior commercial cleaning experience is required.** Experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, property management, or construction is welcome.

Why Join SunClean?

**We look out for each other, and we all want to win.** We share what works, push each other to improve, and celebrate when a teammate hits a goal. If a conversation gets tough, you have people you can talk it through with. If you find an approach that works, you can help the next person get better, too.

As SunClean grows, you’ll have room to grow personally, professionally, and financially. You’ll build confidence speaking with decision-makers, develop the judgment to recognize a real opportunity, and learn to handle rejection without losing momentum. You’ll earn **performance-based bonuses** , with room to take on more responsibility and pursue a path into senior sales, account management, or leadership.

Benefits:

* Paid time off

**About Us**

Bogart Construction is a licensed commercial general contractor with more than 30 years of experience delivering tenant improvements and ground-up projects nationwide. Our portfolio includes grocery, retail, restaurant, automotive, entertainment, and more. At Bogart Construction, our greatest asset is our people. We place a high value on investing not only in the growth of our company but also in the development and success of our team.

**Job Description**

The Assistant Project Manager (APM) supports the Project Manager in the planning, execution, and successful completion of commercial construction projects. This position will primarily support retail renovation, expansion, and ground-up projects, while developing the skills necessary to independently manage projects. The APM is responsible for project documentation, subcontractor administration, procurement tracking, compliance management, change order support, scheduling assistance, and coordination with field operations. The APM may be assigned to manage smaller projects up to approximately $3,000,000 in contract value under the direction of the Project Manager and Project Executive.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator

**Company:** Componentry  
**Location:** Fremont, CA — fully onsite  
**Reports to:** President  
**Type:** Full-time, non-exempt, hourly  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m., including a 30-minute unpaid meal break  
**Pay:** $28–$42 per hour, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated skills

About Componentry

Componentry helps hardware companies source and manage materials, build electronic and electromechanical assemblies, and keep production moving. We work as an extension of our customers’ teams, from quoting and procurement through production.

We’re looking for a Project Coordinator to connect the people, information, and actions needed to carry customer jobs from order review through delivery.

The role

You’ll maintain a clear picture of active jobs, follow up on commitments, identify risks, and coordinate solutions so work keeps moving.

Working directly with our President, you’ll partner with procurement, receiving, production, suppliers, and customers. You’ll track what has been purchased, what is outstanding, what is ready to kit or build, and what needs to happen to meet delivery commitments.

You’ll own the shared job dashboard and connect existing purchasing sheets, receiving records, and production schedules. Information should be accessible to the team without someone having to reconstruct a status report whenever an update is needed.

We’re open to training someone with strong organization, initiative, and follow-through. Your independence and decision-making authority will grow as you learn our business and demonstrate sound judgment.

What you’ll ownJob planning and visibility

* Review new orders against quoted lead times, checking material availability and production capacity with the team.
* Establish job milestones and flag conditions that could affect the expected schedule.
* Maintain the shared job dashboard, including purchasing progress, material delivery dates, receiving status, kit readiness, production, inspection, and shipment.
* Connect information across existing records and improve trackers and handoffs where needed.
* Keep blockers, next actions, owners, and deadlines visible.
* Establish regular updates with the team and escalate missing information or unresolved actions that put delivery at risk.
* Maintain traceability between customer jobs, purchase orders, and materials, including purchases supporting multiple jobs.

Follow-through and recovery

* Follow up with procurement on unpurchased items, supplier commitments, outstanding deliveries, and purchasing blockers.
* Follow up with receiving and production on discrepancies, kit completion, build progress, inspection, and rework.
* Identify stalled work, establish the next action with the responsible person, and follow through to resolution.
* Develop recovery plans with procurement and production, using their expertise to evaluate feasible options.
* Coordinate recovery actions and authorize expenses within established limits as responsibility grows.
* Escalate competing customer priorities, unresolved feasibility disagreements, and decisions outside your authority with options and a recommendation.
* Raise risks early enough for the team to respond.

Customer and supplier communication

* Confirm customer requirements, requested dates, and delivery arrangements.
* Obtain supplier shipment commitments, tracking information, and missing documents.
* Communicate job progress, outstanding dependencies, and schedule changes clearly.
* Work with the team and customer to agree on achievable recovery dates within established authority.
* Document commitments and confirm completion through customer delivery.
* Keep the President informed through frequent, concise updates and priority discussions.
* Clearly hand off unresolved issues requiring attention after your workday ends.

Project-related support

* Assist with sourcing, purchasing follow-ups, and documentation needed to move assigned jobs forward.
* Coordinate resolution of supplier account or administrative issues affecting project schedules.
* Take on other defined projects as agreed with the President, with priorities adjusted to match available capacity.

How responsibilities fit together

Procurement owns purchasing records and supplier purchasing activity. Receiving owns receiving records and material discrepancies. Production owns its schedule and execution.

You own the integrated job dashboard, cross-team follow-through, and coordination through customer delivery. You’ll work with these team members to identify risks, evaluate their recommendations, and drive next steps.

You’ll have the President’s backing to request timely updates, establish action deadlines with the team, and escalate unresolved commitments. Functional leads remain accountable for execution within their areas.

The President resolves competing customer priorities, significant escalations, and decisions beyond your authority. Customer delivery takes priority over additional internal projects.

What we’re looking for

* Evidence of taking responsibility and seeing work through completion.
* Strong organization across multiple tasks, deadlines, and changing priorities.
* Resourcefulness when information is missing or instructions are incomplete.
* Willingness to ask questions, learn from feedback, and apply what you learn.
* Confidence following up with experienced teammates, suppliers, and customers.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Attention to detail with dates, quantities, part numbers, documents, and records.
* Judgment about when to act, when to seek input, and when to escalate.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, shared trackers, email, and business software.
* A collaborative approach and dependable follow-through without repeated reminders.

Relevant experience may come from project coordination, administration, purchasing, logistics, retail, hospitality, or other responsibilities requiring organization and owne

jobs.title: Research Program Coordinator – Reproductive Health
jobs.description:
**Employment Duration:** 6 months

The Research Program Coordinator will serve as a key analyst and coordinator supporting the programmatic and research activities of the Principal Investigator within UCSF’s Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences.

The position supports multiple grant-funded research projects focused on patient-provider communication, particularly in the areas of pharmacies, sexual and reproductive health, and empathy in healthcare. The Coordinator will conduct moderately complex qualitative and quantitative analytical work, support manuscript preparation and submission, and coordinate research, teaching, and mentorship activities. The research does not involve clinical trials.

The Coordinator will collaborate with UCSF departments, the San Francisco Department of Public Health, research and administrative partners, and outside consultants. The role will also evaluate research processes, data collection and storage practices, and available technologies and services to identify alternatives and make sound recommendations.

The position is within UCSF’s Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences, a major academic department in the School of Medicine committed to healthcare, education, and research. The role is based within the department’s Zuckerberg San Francisco General division, whose mission includes promoting justice, quality, and equity in women’s healthcare.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct qualitative and quantitative data collection, cleaning, analysis, and other analytical activities supporting multiple research studies focused on patient-provider communication, pharmacies, sexual and reproductive health, and empathy in healthcare.
* Develop and support systems for research data collection, research-subject communication, and confidential data management.
* Prepare, edit, and modify manuscripts, presentations, abstracts, study instruments, research posters, syllabus materials, letters of recommendation, and other research-related documents.
* Conduct professional literature reviews and gather, synthesize, and analyze information to prepare reports and analyses for the Principal Investigator.
* Prepare and present research summaries, reports, and other materials for meetings and internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate research, teaching, and mentorship activities, including meetings, conference activities, research activities, grant applications, vendor selection and setup, and joint abstract submissions.
* Coordinate program and project activities with research and project staff and collaborate across UCSF departments and administrative units.
* Interface with partners including the Office of Sponsored Research, Research Administration, and San Francisco Department of Public Health departments as needed.
* Evaluate issues and research processes, gather relevant information, assess alternatives, and recommend approaches to data collection and storage based on available technologies and services.
* Support activities that advance UCSF PRIDE Values and Principles of Community and contribute to an inclusive environment where individuals are treated with dignity and respect.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any area.
* At least one year of related experience or equivalent training.
* Working knowledge of common organizational or research-specific computer applications, including Microsoft Office, particularly word processing and intermediate Excel functions.
* Proficient verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities within demanding timeframes.
* Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality.
* Demonstrated ability to use sound judgment when responding to issues and concerns.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, research, and synthesize large amounts of data with strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrated interest in sexual and reproductive health, including comfort with family planning and abortion, and infectious diseases including HIV.
* Knowledge of qualitative research concepts and applications.
Ability to take initiative and direction and complete tasks in a timely and comprehensive manner.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in public health, behavioral science, or another related area.
* Three years of experience working in an academic, research, public health, or related setting.
* Knowledge of survey software such as REDCap or Qualtrics.

  

**About UCSF**

  

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

  
  

**Pride Values**

  

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .

  

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. jobs.title: Event Coordinator (Security)
jobs.description:
Surefox North America Inc is a veteran-owned company that strives to create a diverse and unique culture of trained and talented individuals. We are currently seeking individuals with military, law enforcement, or security experience to join our team as an Event Coordinator.  
  
You will be working on a special event under the guidance of the Shift Supervisors and Area Managers for one of our top clients. As an Event Coordinator, you will act as an ambassador for Surefox and its clients while being responsible for and ensuring the overall safety and security of our client's employees and property. In this role, you will perform a variety of tasks, including but not limited to: access control, employee and guest engagement and verification measures, customer service level support and assistance, active patrolling and monitoring of client facilities, and responding to medical and non-medical emergency events.
  
  
Additionally, you will be expected to keep detailed notes throughout any incident you are a part of and will be asked to compile these notes with your coworkers to create an incident report after the fact. We are looking for someone who has exceptional observational skills and pays close attention to detail as well as being highly dependable. To be successful in this position, you must be able to handle the physical demands of the role and the activity required as part of the static or foot patrol responsibilities of the various positions. An Event Resilience Officer will also be expected to provide top-tier customer service when interacting with personnel on our client campuses and will be expected to have great communication skills. You must also be able to engage with a variety of individuals as part of your daily routine while ensuring that you are maintaining a professional and respectful interaction.
  
  
As we encourage veterans and candidates currently in the military reserve to apply, we welcome all who share the same passion for protection as we do. We are not offering visa sponsorship for this position at this time.  
  
Work Location: Sunnyvale, CA (in office)  
Work Schedule: Monday - Friday (0800 - 1600 PST)  
Compensation: Annual Salary - $105,000.00 - $115,000.00

Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; coaching and mentoring employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Generate sales of data center cooling equipment, controls, and services; manage mix and pricing to achieve margin goals and grow market share in the assigned territory.
* Build and maintain relationships with key decision makers across data center owners, operators, developers, consulting MEP engineers, general contractors, commissioning agents and mechanical contractors.

* Lead complex, long-cycle pursuits from early design influence through specification, bid, award, and handoff to project delivery, coordinating with applications engineering, project management, and service teams.

* Working knowledge of data center cooling technologies (chilled water plants, air-side systems, liquid cooling, redundancy concepts, and efficiency metrics)

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Business Partner to the CEO
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant & Business Partner to the CEO — (San Francisco, CA)**

**Full-time | In-person | 5+ years of relevant experience required**

**FurtherAI** is building the AI Workspace for Insurance, empowering underwriters, brokers, and carriers to automate routine work so they can focus on higher-value decisions. We move fast, prioritize clarity and quality, and value effective, high-integrity work.

**The role**
------------

This is not a traditional EA job. You'll be the CEO's right hand: part Executive Assistant, part Executive Business Partner, and the owner of how it feels to work at FurtherAI day to day.

You'll own the CEO's time, priorities, and follow-through end to end, so the most important work keeps moving and nothing falls between conversations. You'll also build the workplace experience from the ground up: our office, our rituals, our offsites, and the small details that make a fast-growing team feel like a team.

The best person for this role acts as a force multiplier. You anticipate needs before they're voiced, reduce the CEO's cognitive load, and bring the judgment to decide what deserves attention and what doesn't. As we scale, this role grows with you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Run the CEO's time and attention**

* Own the CEO's calendar end to end: sequence priorities, protect focus time, anticipate conflicts, and decide what truly needs their time.
* Triage the CEO's inbox, surface what matters, and draft clear, thoughtful replies on their behalf.
* Coordinate complex scheduling across customers, investors, candidates, press, and the internal team.
* Plan travel and logistics end to end, with the right prep and follow-through built in.
* Handle occasional personal logistics (appointments, vendors, travel) with discretion and sound judgment.

### **Be a true business partner**

* Make sure the CEO walks into every key meeting prepared: agendas, pre-reads, context, and who's in the room.
* Capture decisions and action items, then drive follow-through so nothing important gets lost.
* Build and run a lightweight operating system for priorities, open loops, and commitments.
* Own logistics and prep for board meetings, investor updates, and leadership syncs.
* Take on special projects with the CEO and leadership team: research, process improvements, and cross-functional initiatives.

### **Own the workplace experience**

* Run the San Francisco office: space, vendors, supplies, food, and making sure it works for the team every day.
* Plan team offsites, all-hands, celebrations, and customer or candidate events.
* Partner with Recruiting and People on onboarding, so every new hire feels welcome and productive from day one.
* Shape and scale our culture through rituals, engagement initiatives, and internal communications.
* Build the processes and documentation that help the office and team run smoothly as we grow across locations.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **First 30 days:** You know the CEO's priorities, working style, and key relationships. Their calendar and inbox run smoothly, and you've got a handle on how the office runs today.
* **First 90 days:** You're trusted to make calls on the CEO's behalf. You've built the operating rhythm for meeting prep and follow-through, and you've run your first offsite or company event.
* **First year:** The CEO spends more of their time on the highest-impact work because of you. The workplace experience is something candidates notice and the team is proud of.

The New York City Mayor’s Office is responsible for overseeing city services throughout the five boroughs, coordinating public agencies and departments, and managing public property. **Job Description**
-------------------

To be considered for this position candidate must be serving permanently or be reachable on the civil service list.
  
  
The New York City Department of Transportation (DOT) Office of Construction Mitigation and Coordination (OCMC)-Streets is tasked with coordinating all construction activity occurring within the City’s roadways and sidewalks as well as reviewing all construction permit applications and developing traffic stipulations. Our primary goal is to allow construction activity to occur with minimal disruption to businesses, motorists, bicyclists, and pedestrians, while avoiding conflicts with special events and other construction projects. OCMC-Streets interacts with project engineers, other city agencies, community boards, elected officials, and the general public to resolve construction issues related to mobility.
  
  
OCMC-Streets is seeking an ambitious and motivated individual to join our team as Project Coordinator. Under the supervision of the Director of OCMC-Streets, the candidate will act directly as the long-term manager of a specific geographical area within the five boroughs to which they will be assigned, and for which they will be responsible reviewing construction plans for both private and governmental contract work; collecting necessary data and information for the purpose of developing traffic stipulations for incorporation into governmental contracts; reviewing construction permit applications for the purpose of issuing traffic stipulations on construction activity permits; organizing, chairing and attending coordination meetings related to building construction activity occurring on the city’s roadways and sidewalks; conducting in-depth field investigations to develop necessary traffic detours related to construction; and following up with other NYC DOT units, other agencies, contractors and expediters as necessary to ensure construction is occurring according to permit requirements, and community concerns are being addressed. When needed, the candidate will make recommendations for alternative methods of performing construction in order to reduce the impact upon the public. The candidate will also be responsible for investigating complaints received from the public, elected officials, and other agencies, related to construction activity within their geographical review area, and preparing written responses based on obtained permit data and/or information gathered during site visits, and determining any further action to be taken.
  
  
TRANSPORTATION SPECIALIST - 22316

  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  
  

1. A master's degree in transportation engineering, mathematics, urban planning, architecture, landscape architecture, urban studies, or related physical and social science fields; or
  
  
2. A baccalaureate degree in engineering from an accredited college and one year of full-time satisfactory experience performing technical work on roadway transportation and traffic studies and area-wide traffic programs; or
  
  
3. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of full-time satisfactory experience as described in "2" above; or
  
  
4. An associate degree or completion of 60 semester credits from an accredited college and four years of full-time satisfactory experience as described in "2" above; or
  
  
5. A four-year high school diploma or its educational equivalent and six years of full-time satisfactory experience as described in "2" above.
  
  
SPECIAL NOTE:
  
  
In addition to meeting the minimum Qualification Requirements above:
  
  
To be assigned to Assignment Level II, the candidate must have an additional year of experience as described in the "Qualification Requirements" listed under "2" above.
  
  
To be assigned to Assignment Level III, the candidate must have an additional two years of experience as described in the "Qualification Requirements" listed under "2" above.

  
  

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

  
Preference will be given to candidate who possess a driver’s license valid in the State of New York with no restrictions. This license must be maintained throughout duration of employment in this position. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Ability to meet deadlines and work on multiple tasks simultaneously. Excellent written and oral communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills. Ability to review documents for accuracy, identify problems, manage against tight timelines, and prioritize projects. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook. Knowledge of CCU/ARTS and NYC Streets is a plus.
  

**55a Program**
---------------

  
This position is also open to qualified persons with a disability who are eligible for the 55-a Program. Please indicate at the top of your resume and cover letter that you would like to be considered for the position through the 55-a Program.
  

**Public Service Loan Forgiveness**
-----------------------------------

  
As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/.
  

**Residency Requirement**
-------------------------

  
New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of interview.

**Job Title:** Nest and Nourish Program Coordinator
  
**Department:** Food Access Unit
  
**Division:** Center for Health Equity and Community Wellness (CHECWELL)
  
**Bureau:** Bureau of Brooklyn Neighborhood Health
  
**Location:** 485 Throop Avenue, Brooklyn
  
**Reports To Title:** Food Access Program Manager
  
**Direct Reports Title(s):** Food Access Program Intern
  
**Schedule & Hours:** 8-4, 830-430, or 9-5; M-F
  
**Workplace Flexibility Modality:** Hybrid (up to 2 days per week remote)
  
**Work Environment:** Office Environment
  
**Grant End Date:** 09/29/2027
  
**Created Date:** 10/22/2026
  
**Revised Date:** 11/5/2026
  
**Salary:** $72,000
  
**FLSA Classification:** Non - Exempt
  
Who We Are
  
The Fund for Public Health in New York City (FPHNYC) is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization that is dedicated to the advancement of the health and well-being of all New Yorkers. To this end, in partnership with the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), FPHNYC incubates innovative public health initiatives implemented by DOHMH to advance community health throughout the city. It facilitates partnerships, often new and unconventional, between government and the private sector to develop, test, and launch new initiatives. These collaborations speed the execution of demonstration projects, effect expansion of successful pilot programs, and support rapid implementation to meet the public health needs of individuals, families, and communities across New York City.
  
  
Our Culture
  
We embrace a culture of learning, collaboration, innovation, and well-being, where open communication drives our impact.
  
About The Role
  
The Program Coordinator will support the day-to-day implementation of the Nest and Nourish program, a HRSA-funded prescription produce program for pregnant and postpartum individuals. The position will serve as a primary point of contact for participants, including coordinating enrollment, navigation, referrals, follow-up, data collection, and retention activities. The coordinator will work closely with clinical partners, community-based organizations, program staff, and program leadership to ensure effective implementation of the program.
  
About the Program
  
Nest & Nourish is a program of the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s Bureau of Brooklyn Neighborhood Health that aims to improve maternal health by increasing food access and security among pregnant and postpartum participants. The program provides produce benefits, nutrition education, case management, and connections to community resources. This program is one of several food access initiatives in the Bureau of Brooklyn Neighborhood Health.
  
  
Responsibilities
  

* Coordinate participant recruitment, eligibility screening, enrollment, and orientation to services.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for participants during program engagement.
* Conduct regular participants check-ins and assess food access, social needs, and barriers to participation.
* Coordinate distribution and tracking of monthly benefits.
* Monitor participant engagement, voucher redemption, nutrition education participation, and retention. Provide referrals and navigation assistance to other bureau programs and community resource activities.
* Coordinate required nutrition education classes, cooking demonstrations, and other program activities.
* Conduct reminder and re-engagement outreach for participants who miss appointments or program activities.
* Maintain accurate and timely participant records in accordance with program and privacy requirements.
* Collect survey data and other program evaluation data and support monitoring of data quality.
* Support program outreach, community engagement, and recruitment events.
* Prepare routine program updates and identify participants’ needs, barriers, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support grant deliverables, reporting, and program implantation activities.

Requirements
  

* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties described above; or
* High school graduation or equivalent and six years of experience in community work or community centered activities in an area related to the duties as described above; or
* Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least one year of experience as described in "1" above.
* Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
* Excellent organizational skills and highly detailed oriented
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain working relationships with culturally diverse community groups.
* Bilingual (written and spoken) Spanish language proficiency preferred.
* Physical Requirements: Ability to stand for extended periods of time. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check

* A retirement savings plan with generous employer contribution

Communications Broadcast & Multimedia Production Coordinator (aHEO)

**POSITION DETAILS**

Lehman College of The City University of New York (CUNY) seeks a Communications Broadcast & Multimedia Production Coordinator for the School of Continuing and Professional Studies (SCPS). SCPS provides workforce development, continuing education, and adult degree programs that enhance the economic security of the Bronx, serving approximately 7,500 students each year through more than 300 credit and non-credit courses, 35 certificate programs, the Adult Degree Program, and CUNY on the Concourse. The school is positioning itself as the Bronx’s engine for opportunity in the AI age.

Reporting to the Administrative Specialist, the coordinator supports and facilitates the school’s public relations and communications activities. The position tells the SCPS story to students, employers, community partners, and the campus; grows enrollment through digital marketing; manages the school’s social media presence; and supports the Dean in cultivating internal and external partnerships with Lehman schools and departments, employers, unions, community organizations, and government offices. The coordinator also supports the school’s major convenings, such as the Future of Work conference, and produces the newsletters, announcements, and materials that keep the SCPS community informed.

**Duties include:**

* Coordinate and implement an annual communications and marketing plan for SCPS aligned with the school’s strategic plan, enrollment goals, and principles.
* Maintain the school’s social media channels (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and others): plan the content calendar; create posts, photos, and short videos; engage with followers; and report on performance.
* Plan and run digital marketing campaigns for credit and non-credit programs, including email, paid social, search, and landing pages; track leads, conversions, and cost per enrollment, and optimize accordingly.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator, Lifecycle Marketing
jobs.description:
**Position summary**

The Marketing Team at MoMA brings together specialists in Marketing and channel strategies, content and audience development, driven by finding new ways to bring the Museum’s mission and brand positioning to life and by building meaningful relationships with new and existing priority audiences for the institution. This work supports the financial sustainability of MoMA by strengthening the Museum's earned revenue streams.

Reporting to the Senior Marketing Manager, Paid Media, the Lifecycle Marketing Coordinator is the hands-on owner of MoMA's lifecycle and owned-channel retention programs. The role builds, tests, and optimizes email, segmentation, automation, website and landing page experiences, and visibility in search and AI-driven discovery. The focus is the mid- and low-funnel: moving audiences from consideration to visit, ticket purchase, membership, and repeat engagement.

The Coordinator works in alignment with Paid Media so that acquisition and retention operate as one connected customer journey. The Senior Marketing Manager sets channel strategy and priorities; the Coordinator executes, experiments, and reports on results.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lifecycle program ownership
* + Builds and runs always-on lifecycle programs across the customer journey: welcome, pre-visit, post-visit, membership acquisition, and lapsed-user reactivation.
  + Maintains the lifecycle roadmap and the content calendar.
  + Sets success metrics for each program with the Senior Marketing Manager, such as conversion to visit, membership conversion rate, repeat visit rate, and revenue per send.

* CRM and email execution
* + Builds, QA, and sends email campaigns and automated journeys in Klaviyo.
  + Manages list health, deliverability, consent, and compliance.
  + Maintains the newsletter program with Design and Content teams: templates, content planning, and send cadence.
  + Runs documented testing programs across email, journeys, and landing pages; log hypotheses and results, and positive learnings.

* Segmentation and audience data
* + Builds and maintains audience segments with Analytics and Data teams, and applies behavioral signals to the overall strategy.
  + Keeps CRM data inputs, integrations, and tagging accurate and documented.

* Landing page and conversion optimization
* + Plans, builds, and optimizes landing pages for tickets, membership, exhibitions, programs, and events.
  + Owns conversion optimization for mid- and low-funnel pages, working with Digital Product, Design, and Content on templates and tracking.

* Search and AI-driven discovery
* + Optimizes owned content for organic search and AI platforms: structured data, prompts, content structure, and accuracy of MoMA information.
  + Uses Profound to monitor and report on MoMA's visibility in AI search results and recommend and implement fixes.

* Agency relationship, reporting and analysis
* + Builds dashboards and recurring reports in Heap and Google Analytics on lifecycle KPIs and gives data-backed recommendations to the Senior Marketing Manager and Marketing leadership.
  + Partners with the Membership team to support membership conversion goals and develops funnel strategies that improve join, upgrade, and renewal rates.
  + Aligns lifecycle messaging with Ticketing, Visitor Experience, Development, Retail, Editorial, Design, Digital Product, and Analytics.
  + Coordinates with Paid Media Sr. Manager and the agency on audience syncs, retargeting lists, creative handoffs, and paid search and landing page message alignment. Manages Klaviyo and other platform vendors day-to-day.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree and at least three years of hands-on lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience, including expert-level execution in Klaviyo.
* Proficiency in Heap and Google Analytics (GA4): tracking, funnel and cohort analysis, conversion reporting, and attribution. Ability to define KPIs and explain results and next steps to stakeholders.
* Expert knowledge of agentic and AI search visibility, with hands-on experience in Profound, plus working knowledge of SEO
* Ability to build audiences, journeys, and content without engineering support. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email and SQL or equivalent for segmentation.
* Track record of A/B tests that changed program decisions, and of optimizing landing pages and conversion paths in a CMS.
* Knowledge of email deliverability, consent, and privacy compliance requirements.
* Clear written communication, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines across teams.

**Reports to:** Senior Marketing Manager, Paid Media

**Salary:** The salary for this position is $68,190 per annum.

**Application instructions:** To apply, please visit MoMA Jobs (https://recruiting.ultipro.com/MUS1002MOMA/JobBoard/9dbfa465-a36a-46c3-b31e-4929830ab266/?q=&o=postedDateDesc). Applicants must submit a resume and a cover letter. Applications without cover letters will not be considered.

The Office is responsible for reviewing, investigating and managing all incidents from inception through resolution whether the Respondent is a student, faculty, staff member or affiliate.

The Administrative Coordinator will provide administrative and operational support for complaints of protected class discrimination and harassment, retaliation, sex-based harassment, sexual misconduct, stalking, and domestic and dating violence, filed by and against students, employees, faculty, administrators, and third-party affiliates. The Administrative Coordinator will triage and respond to sensitive inquiries and reports from students, faculty, administrators, and family members regarding University resources and policies and procedures administered in accordance with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA).
