Posting Description:

**Who We Are**
==============

Lenox Advisors brings together sophisticated solutions in wealth management and insurance services to high-net-worth individuals and their families. As a wholly owned subsidiary of NFP Corp., an Aon Company, we combine the culture of a boutique firm with the stability and backing of a large corporation to create an environment that's truly unique. NFP is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We’re a recognized Elite Agency award winner and a leading property and casualty broker, benefits consultant, wealth manager, and retirement plan advisor. NFP provides solutions enabling client success through the expertise of over 8,000 global employees, investments in innovative technologies, and enduring relationships with highly rated insurers, vendors and financial institutions. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

**Position Summary & Overall Purpose**
======================================

Lenox Advisors is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Event Coordinator who is passionate about creating exceptional experiences and seeing complex events successfully come to life. This role combines independent ownership with a highly collaborative, team-focused environment. The ideal candidate is someone who can gather input from collaborators, conduct research and site visits, develop creative event concepts, and confidently present recommendations for feedback and approval. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced event professional who is ready to take the next step in their career and fully lead the planning and execution of impactful events that support business growth, client engagement, and organizational objectives.

This hybrid role will be based in New York, NY and requires travel for events including to our Stamford office, as key leaders and event stakeholders are based in each office. The standard schedule is at least three days per week in the office, with willingness to support events on site outside of business hours.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Event Planning & Execution**
------------------------------

* Coordinate end-to-end planning of events including conferences training sessions, corporate meetings, and dinners.
* Develop timelines, run-of-show documents, and detailed logistical plans for each event
* Lead on-site execution including setup, vendor coordination, and issue resolution to ensure excellent delivery

**Vendor & Venue Management**
-----------------------------

* Source, evaluate, and manage relationships with venues and vendors (AV, catering, travel, etc.)
* Negotiate contracts in conjunction with manager and COO and ensure all services align with budget and event objectives
* Coordinate site visits and oversee logistics such as audiovisual needs and space planning in coordination with Lenox IT and the EA team.

**Registration & Attendee Management**
--------------------------------------

* Manage event registration, RSVP tracking, and attendee communications together with the marketing team
* Prepare registration reports and maintain accurate participant data (e.g., tracking RSVPs and headcount for events)
* Coordinate event communications (invitations, registration follow ups, “Know Before You Go” emails, etc.)

**Stakeholder Collaboration**
-----------------------------

* Partner with executive leadership, executive assistants, event host, marketing, and external partners to align on event goals and messaging
* Serve as a central point of contact across internal teams and vendors
* Collaborate with marketing on event materials, branding, and communications

**Budget & Reporting**
----------------------

* Support event budget creation and track expenses to ensure cost efficiency
* Process invoices and vendor payments
* Deliver post-event reporting including attendance, feedback, and recommendations for improvement

**On-Site Operations**
----------------------

* Oversee onsite execution including registration, vendor coordination, and troubleshooting and coordinate with the event management vendor if one is hired
* Ensure all event elements run according to plan and meet Lenox quality standards
* Provide a high-touch, professional experience for advisors, clients, and partners
* Travel in the NYC & tri-state area required approximately 25% of the time
* Events will sometimes fall outside of normal business hours

**Qualifications**
==================

* 5+ years of experience in event coordination, preferably in corporate, financial services, or professional services environments
* Proven experience managing multiple events simultaneously with strong attention to detail
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
* Experience working with executive leadership, senior stakeholders and external partners
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and event management tools/platforms
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, or related field preferred

jobs.description:

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams **win the talent war**.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside **5,000+** customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR **with 20%+ monthly growth**, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over **$116M** in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.

**About the Role**

This is a front-line manager role for a CS team that owns the full revenue motion: expansions and renewals across a book of mid-market and enterprise customers. You'll manage a team of CSMs who are part consultant, part account manager, part AI workflow expert, and you'll be the person who makes them great. Expect to be in deals, on calls, and in the weeds with your team when it matters. You'll also be a builder. We're writing the CS playbook as we fly the plane and we need a manager who has a point of view on what great looks like and the drive to make it real. You report directly to the VP of CS.

You'll define what customer success looks like in an AI-first world at a hypergrowth company becoming a category leader. The foundation is already in place: customers love the product, relationships are strong, and commercial results speak for themselves. Your opportunity is to scale that into a world-class CS organization alongside a low-ego, collaborative team, working directly with a VP of Customer Success who previously built leading CS organizations at Gong, Slack, and Zendesk.

**You Will…**

* **Coach and develop your team:** Run deal reviews, listen to calls, and deliver direct, actionable feedback that elevates performance.
* **Own team performance:** Drive GRR, NRR, and expansion goals through accurate forecasting and strong pipeline management.
* **Be a player-coach:** Jump into complex renewals and expansions, helping CSMs navigate stakeholders, pricing, and negotiations.
* **Build the playbook:** Continuously improve renewal, expansion, QBR, success planning, and forecasting processes.
* **Partner cross-functionally:** Collaborate with Sales, Product, and leadership to improve the customer experience and shape GTM strategy.

* 5+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales, including 2+ years managing a revenue-owning team. We care more about what you've built than your title.
* Proven success leading teams that consistently exceed GRR, NRR, and expansion targets.
* Strong commercial instincts with a track record of coaching others to improve.
* A builder who has introduced processes and programs that measurably improved a CS organization.
* High standards, high accountability, and a coaching style that elevates team performance.
* Executive presence with customers, cross-functional partners, and senior leadership.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Serval is the AI-native enterprise service management platform that automates the work legacy IT service management tools only track. Our AI agents build the automations that power employee support, then resolve requests against them instantly—helping teams across IT, HR, finance, legal, and beyond automate work within one governed platform.

Companies including Fox, Live Nation, Notion, Ramp, and Lucid Motors run on Serval. Headquartered in San Francisco, we’ve raised $277 million from investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, First Round, General Catalyst, and Elad Gil, most recently a $150 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation.

We’re building a team that moves quickly, takes ownership, and wants to make a meaningful impact on how the world’s largest organizations work. Come help us build what’s next for enterprise service management.

**About The Role**
------------------

The Content Marketing Manager owns the content engine that turns Serval's point of view into pipeline. You will plan, write, and ship the stories, customer narratives, and campaigns that reach CIOs and IT leaders, and make sure each piece earns its place in the funnel.  
This is a builder role on a small, fast team. You will write a lot yourself, set the editorial bar, and partner closely with brand, product marketing, demand gen, and sales. You report to Alana O'Grady.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Write and ship.** Plan and run a 12-month content roadmap mapped to funnel stage, buyer persona, and pipeline goals. Produce blog posts, long-form guides, web copy, and campaign assets. Most weeks you will publish something you wrote.
* **Tell customer stories.** Interview customers and turn their results into case studies, quotes, and proof points sales can use.
* **Build thought leadership.** Shape executive points of view with our founders and leaders, and turn them into bylines, posts, and talks.
* **Distribute, not just publish.** Repurpose each major piece across web, email, social, and events so one idea reaches the right buyers several ways.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 5+ years in content marketing, with at least 2 in B2B SaaS selling to technical or enterprise buyers.
* A portfolio of writing you are proud of: long-form pieces, customer stories, and campaign work with clear results.
* Strong editorial judgment. You can take a messy idea from a founder or engineer and make it sharp, accurate, and readable.
* Comfort with technical subjects. You can learn how IT, identity, and service management work well enough to write credibly for CIOs.
* A track record tying content to pipeline, not just page views.
* Ownership and speed. You ship without waiting for permission, take feedback well, and push back when you disagree.
* Clear, direct written communication. Substance over slogans, no hype words.

**Bonus!**
----------

* Ghostwriting for founders or executives on LinkedIn and in bylines.
* SEO and AI search (answer engine) optimization experience.
* Comfort using AI tools in your writing workflow while keeping the output unmistakably human.
* Experience producing video, podcast, or event content.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Impact**: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.
* **Growth**: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.
* **Culture**: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.

Compensation Range: $170K - $220K

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**WHY UJA, WHY NOW?**

Big problems need big solutions. And for more than a century, UJA-Federation of New York has been at the center of Jewish New York, bringing people and partners together to meet challenges no single organization can solve alone.

Today, these challenges are more urgent than ever: rising antisemitism, the enduring impact of October 7 on Israeli society, and the rising cost of living right here at home. At the same time, we’re seeing something new and powerful: Jewish community members yearning to connect, to show up proudly Jewish, and to be part of something larger than themselves.

At this moment, UJA’s role has never been more important. And how we tell our story matters: building awareness of our work, deepening engagement, and helping people feel connected to a community they want to be part of.

If this sounds like work you’d love to do, we hope you’ll apply.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

You know that a social feed is more than a collection of posts. It’s a place where people start conversations, build community, respond in real time, and keep coming back for more. And it’s one of the most visible ways UJA shows up in the world.

As UJA’s Social Media Manager, you’ll shape what that looks like—and help make UJA a must-follow voice in the Jewish community. You’ll lead the strategy and day-to-day work, find fresh ways to tell our story, and elevate the voices of our leadership, partners, and the people behind our work.

You’ll also lead our influencer partnerships, connecting with creators and leading voices in the Jewish community to reach new audiences. And you’ll manage and mentor our Social Media Associate while collaborating with colleagues across UJA.

The work moves fast, the news doesn’t wait, and no two days look the same. You’re unflappable and ready for all of it.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Make UJA a voice people want to follow**

* Lead UJA’s social media strategy and oversee its execution across our platforms.
* Find creative ways to tell the stories of UJA and our nonprofit partners, identifying the right moments, messages, and platforms to extend their reach.
* Develop organic social strategies for major events, working with speakers, influencers, donors, fundraisers, and other partners.
* Partner with content, video, email, and design colleagues to create more compelling, platform-appropriate content—and give good stories a longer life across channels.
* Stay on top of emerging platforms, trends, and best practices, and test new approaches that make sense for UJA.
* ⁠Oversee engagement with UJA’s community of followers to nurture relationships

**Lead a team and build strong partnerships**

* Manage and mentor the Social Media Associate and interns, providing direction, feedback, and oversight of day-to-day work and community engagement.

* Manage relationships, contracts, billing, and renewals for social platforms, tools, and vendors.

**Connect the dots across channels**

* Contribute to an integrated digital content strategy across social, web, and email.
* Develop stories, articles, visuals, and campaign assets using interviews and internal and external sources.
* Maintain an editorial calendar for UJA’s social channels and identify opportunities to bring UJA’s work to life.
* Help connect content to broader goals, including audience engagement, lead generation, and user journeys.

**Build influencer partnerships**

* Identify and build relationships with influencers, creators, and leading voices who can introduce UJA to new audiences and deepen engagement with our work.
* Shape paid and organic influencer collaborations, guide the creative, and oversee the Social Media Associate’s work on logistics and administration.

**Know when—and how—to respond**

* Monitor social conversations, relevant news, and UJA’s online reputation.
* Identify and escalate emerging issues, bringing good judgment and a clear sense of urgency.
* Work with PR and marketing leadership to develop and coordinate social responses during sensitive or fast-moving moments.

**WHO YOU ARE**

You have your finger on the pulse of cultural conversations, both inside and outside the Jewish world. You’re as comfortable shaping a social strategy as you are getting a post out the door, from design to copy. You think in words *and* pictures, know the ins and outs of each platform, and have the judgment to know when—and how—to join the conversation.

You’re a savvy, diplomatic relationship-builder and team player who works well with all kinds of people, from creative teams and fundraisers to senior leadership and external partners. You thrive under pressure and are a master juggler.

**You bring:**

* 5–10 years of marketing experience, with demonstrated results in campaign strategy and execution.
* Experience managing campaigns across major social platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, and Threads.

-------------------

These woven coverings for tabletops, floors, walls, windows, furnishings, and more are made in the United States, and the design-driven company operates its own factory in Chatsworth, Georgia. Available in more than 100 countries, Chilewich products feature innovative weaves, multi-tonal colors, indoor/outdoor versatility, and easy maintenance. Seven Chilewich designs are in the permanent collection of the Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum. To learn more, visit** **www.chilewich.com****.**

**Digital Marketing Lead**
--------------------------

------------

Full Time

------------

New York, NY (Hybrid)

Vice President, Digital

$90,000–$100,000

**The Digital Marketing Lead owns Chilewich’s email, SMS, and customer relationship management (CRM) programs as a member of the digital team, reporting to the Vice President, Digital. In this role, the Digital Marketing Lead will develop and execute email and SMS strategy in Klaviyo, lead CRM strategy and reporting focused on retention and repeat purchase, and manage Chilewich’s omnichannel loyalty program. The role also partners with Chilewich’s Digital Marketing agency on paid advertising efforts. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.**

This is a full-time exempt position based in New York City, with the opportunity to work from home two days a week.

-------------------------

* Ability to sit at a desk for prolonged periods while working on a computer.
* Ability to lift 5 pounds.

jobs.description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.

Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns **25** plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in **26** countries, and employs approximately **4,700** people.

Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Logistics Coordinator to support the day-to-day execution of our logistics and transportation operations. This role is responsible for coordinating shipments, maintaining accurate logistics documentation and system data, communicating with internal teams and external logistics partners, and helping resolve shipment-related issues.

The ideal candidate is proactive, comfortable working in a fast-paced supply chain environment, and able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and customer service.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and monitor inbound and outbound shipments to support timely delivery of goods.
* Work closely with carriers, freight forwarders, warehouses, distribution centers, suppliers, and internal business partners.

* Track shipments and proactively communicate delays, exceptions, shortages, damages, or other service issues.
* Support freight appointment scheduling, shipment releases, delivery coordination, and proof-of-delivery follow-up.
* Maintain accurate logistics and shipment information in ERP, transportation, warehouse, and related business systems.
* Assist with freight invoice research, accessorial charges, discrepancies, and supporting documentation.
* Partner with Customer Service, Planning, Warehousing, Procurement, Finance, and other Supply Chain teams to resolve operational issues.
* Support inventory movements, transfers, shipment reconciliation, and research of discrepancies as needed.
* Maintain organized electronic records and documentation to support internal controls, audits, and operational requirements.
* Assist with logistics reporting and the monitoring of key service and operational metrics.

* Follow established company procedures and applicable transportation, trade, safety, and compliance requirements.
* Provide administrative and operational support to the Logistics team as required.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related discipline
* 1–3 years of experience in logistics, transportation, warehousing, supply chain, customer service, order management, or a related field.
* Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple shipments, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, and Microsoft Teams.
* Comfortable working with ERP, transportation, warehouse, or similar business systems.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to follow issues through to resolution.
* Ability to work effectively with both internal teams and external logistics providers.

**Preferred**

* Experience working with SAP or another ERP system.
* Experience with transportation management systems (TMS), warehouse management systems (WMS), or carrier portals.
* Experience coordinating truckload, LTL, parcel, import/export, or intercompany shipments.
* Familiarity with freight documentation, inventory transactions, and transportation terminology.
* Experience within the consumer goods, beverage, food, or other high-volume distribution environment.

**Key Competencies**

* Execution: Takes ownership of tasks and follows shipments and issues through completion.
* Attention to Detail: Maintains accurate shipment, inventory, and documentation records.
* Communication: Provides clear and timely information to internal and external stakeholders.
* Problem Solving: Quickly identifies exceptions and works collaboratively toward resolution.
* Prioritization: Effectively balances competing operational requirements and deadlines.
* Collaboration: Builds productive relationships across Supply Chain and with external logistics partners.
* Continuous Improvement: Looks for practical opportunities to simplify processes and improve execution.

Our team comes from the intersection of defense technology and AI. We've built and shipped products to DoD customers, and we bring deep experience across ML, robotics, product development, and defense.

We’re hiring an Executive Assistant & Operations Associate to be the right hand to our CEO and founders. You’ll keep the company moving at full speed. The Assistant Project Manager (APM) will serve as a vital team member while assisting the Senior Project Manager and/or Project Manager on all aspects of a project. APM’s will be expected to take on central roles for the oversight of the Project Engineer with a specific focus on document control (RFIs, submittals, material delivery, etc.), subcontractor coordination, design team communication, project reporting and overall representation of Consigli throughout the entirety of the project.

### **Responsibilities / Essential Functions**

* Serve as a main point of contact for communication with Owners, OPMs and Design Teams members.
* Coordinate and provide input during weekly meetings with subcontractors, design teams, and owner representatives to resolve field conflicts and drive resolution.
* Support project cost and change management process: prepare reports for review with other team members and present at both Owner and internal meetings.
* Assist in development of estimates and bid proposals for both lump sum and GMP projects.
* Oversight/Management of Project Engineer and associated responsibilities including document Control, RFIs, Submittals, Material Delivery Tracking and Meeting Minutes.
* Mentor: support, develop, and train supporting team members, including Project Engineers.
* Maintain close relations with subcontractors, including early notification of submittal & material delivery schedule expectations.
* Monitor executed subcontracts and insurance certificates; verify contracts and insurance are in place prior to commencing work.
* Coordinate with Project Scheduler to update and distribute project master schedule with input from Superintendent and project team.
* Assist the project Superintendent and other team members in the resolution of all critical issues, RFI’s, etc. with a focus on quality, cost and schedule; provide documentation as necessary.
* Take ownership of the closeout process: complete and implement project closeout checklist.
* Manage close-out documentation (as-builts, O&Ms, warranties, test reports, etc.) for submission to Design Team and Owner.
* Manage financial closeout process with subcontractors and Owner.
* Punch List: Upload and distribute the punch list through Procore to subcontractors.
* Assist with coordinating work completion as required and maintain an accurate log of items to be completed.
* Observations and Field Reports: work with project team to conduct field walks as necessary and compile any corresponding documentation accordingly. Review Design Team field reports and work with required parties to resolve open items and drive to resolutions.
* Safety: perform regular safety walks with field and safety staff and record observations.

### **Key Skills**

* Strong communication skills.
* Ability to review, understand and support all change management processes.
* Strong initiative and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to multi-task and self-prioritize.
* Motivated and driven.
* Ability to work in a team environment with a primary focus on collaboration.
* Excellent written and verbal presentation skills.

### **Required Experience**

* A bachelor's degree in engineering, Construction Management or Architecture preferred.
* 3 - 5 years’ experience within the construction industry in project management or similar role.
* OSHA 10 and OSHA-30 preferred.
* Additional proficiencies may include cost management software (Timberline, Sage preferred), scheduling software (Primavera P6 preferred) and construction management software (Procore preferred).

The Share For Life Foundation, Inc. is a nonprofit dedicated to supporting underserved communities by enriching the lives of youth and their families through a holistic educational approach.

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant to the CEO to support across community outreach, communications, scheduling, intern coordination, and organizational support.

This is a high-trust support role that strengthens the foundation’s partnerships, visibility, and community engagement efforts, while also helping expand outreach and operational capacity.

This is a hybrid position (1 day per week in-office in Harlem, NY 10027) with a commitment of between 10 - 20 hours per week.

jobs.description:
**About Ballpark Music:**  
Ballpark Music (BPM) specializes in producing large-scale postgame concerts in stadiums across the country. BPM handles booking and producing concerts for teams that engage fans, boost attendance and enhance the bottom line of the event. Since inception in 2015, BPM has produced nearly 400 concerts on stadium fields with artists like Chris Stapleton, Snoop Dogg, Zac Brown Band, Marshmello, Thomas Rhett, Weezer, Run DMC, The Avett Brothers, T-Pain, Diplo, Old Dominion, Ludacris, Sam Hunt, AJR, Jordan Davis, Riley Green, Nelly and many, many more. BPM has also handled the on-field production for MLB’s All-Star Week (2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), as well as trophy presentations for the ALCS, NLCS and World Series since 2017.  
  
**Job Summary:**  
We are seeking a talented and driven individual to join Ballpark Music. This person will be directly assisting the President of BPM in all areas including, but not limited to, artist management communications, presenting concert ideas to teams, contract negotiations, maintaining schedules and organized event planning, office management, company HR needs, paperwork coordination, and any activities that keep the company, and the President, running smoothly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing all marketing efforts related to upcoming concerts in collaboration with the BPM clients and artists. You will be tracking and coordinating all promotional assets to ensure successful marketing campaigns are being executed. You will also be on site for each show, ensuring a positive relationship with both the Teams and the Artists.  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**  

* Support the President of BPM with all concert preparation, execution and day-to-day operations
* Coordinate with clients & artist management to track, gather, and approve all necessary assets for concert promotion
* Act as the primary point of contact for all marketing assets for BPM clients
* Help implement strategic marketing plans for upcoming concerts to maximize audience engagement and ticket sales
* Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices in both the sports and entertainment sectors to identify new marketing opportunities
* Act as the point of contact for non-technical elements for shows including, but not limited to, coordinating catering, hospitality, crew calls, hotel arrangements, flights, ground, stagehands, techs, show logistics and the show itself
* No job too big, no job too small – this position, like everyone at BPM, will be involved in every facet of planning and executing each show. You will be involved in high level conceptualization of creating world-class events as well as making sure crews have water on site and everything in-between.

  
**Job Skills & Qualifications:**  

* Amazing personal skills and relationship building
* Excellent organizational, oral, and written communication skills
* Bachelor’s degree. Preferably in marketing, business, music production, or sports-related disciplines
* 2+ years of applicable experience with a team, agency or in concert production
* The ability to travel as needed – heavy travel from May to October
* Lift up to 30lbs and be able to stand for long periods of time

  
If you are passionate about both sports and entertainment and thrive in a dynamic and  
exciting environment, we encourage you to apply for this opportunity. Join us in shaping  
unforgettable concert experiences and enhancing the intersection of sports and  
entertainment! Please note that this job description is a general overview and may, and  
will, be subject to further refinement and customization based on specific organizational  
needs.

Competitive base salary with monthly commission opportunities

jobs.title: ECOMMERCE ACCOUNT MANAGER – HOME DEPOT.COM & AMAZON
jobs.description:
**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Gama Sonic USA is seeking a results-driven **Ecommerce Account Manager** to lead the growth and day-to-day management of our **Home Depot.com and Amazon businesses**, with **Home Depot.com as the primary focus**.

This position is responsible for overall account performance, retailer portals, product catalogs, sales analysis, pricing, inventory, forecasting, promotions, account health, reporting, and retailer requirements.

**This is an account management and business ownership role, not primarily a marketing position.** Gama Sonic has a Marketing team in place to manage advertising, creative, content, and promotional execution. This position will work closely with Marketing while owning the overall ecommerce accounts and coordinating the internal teams needed to drive results.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on **Home Depot.com experience**, understands the Home Depot ecommerce ecosystem, and has experience working with **Supplier Hub and Askuity**. Amazon experience is also important, but Home Depot expertise is the primary requirement.

This position reports to the **Vice President of Sales** and works closely with Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Product Development, and Finance.

**Hybrid position based in Norcross, GA – two days remote and three days in the office.**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Home Depot.com Account Management – Primary Focus**

* Own the day-to-day management and overall performance of the Home Depot.com business.
* Manage Home Depot vendor portals and systems, including **Supplier Hub and Askuity**.
* Monitor sales, traffic, conversion, availability, sell-through, pricing, inventory, and competitive activity.
* Analyze Home Depot reporting and identify opportunities to improve sales and profitability.
* Manage product assortment, SKU setup, product information, content, attributes, and catalog accuracy.
* Monitor and resolve content, inventory, pricing, fulfillment, compliance, and other account issues.
* Monitor product availability and identify issues that may negatively impact customer conversion or sales.
* Support new product launches, promotions, assortment expansion, and seasonal programs.
* Work with Home Depot contacts and internal teams to resolve issues and improve account performance.
* Participate in retailer meetings, business reviews, and account planning as needed.
* Maintain strong knowledge of Home Depot.com processes, requirements, reporting, and ecommerce expectations.

**Amazon Account Management**

* Manage the day-to-day ecommerce business and performance of the Amazon account.
* Manage Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central, including account health, compliance, catalog, reporting, and performance metrics.
* Monitor sales, traffic, conversion, pricing, Buy Box, inventory, profitability, and competitive activity.
* Manage SKU setup, listings, product information, variations, and catalog accuracy.
* Monitor FBA inventory, replenishment, sell-through, and storage utilization.
* Coordinate with external Amazon advertising partners and analyze TACoS, ACOS, ROAS, CPC, and conversion.
* Support pricing, promotions, coupons, new product launches, and assortment expansion.

**Sales, Reporting & Analytics**

* Develop weekly and monthly account reporting and performance dashboards.
* Analyze sales trends by SKU, category, and channel.
* Identify underperforming products and opportunities for growth.
* Monitor pricing, promotions, inventory, conversion, and profitability.
* Use retailer reporting and analytics tools to identify trends, issues, and opportunities.
* Provide clear recommendations and account updates to the Vice President of Sales.

**Cross-Functional Account Management**

* Serve as the internal owner and primary coordinator for Home Depot.com and Amazon.
* Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Product Development, and Finance.
* Communicate account priorities and drive issues through resolution.
* Monitor retailer communications, requirements, deadlines, and compliance.
* Coordinate with Marketing on content, promotions, advertising, and product launches rather than independently owning marketing execution.
* Develop processes that improve account performance and execution.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree preferred.
* **3+ years of experience managing Home Depot.com, Amazon, or major ecommerce/retail accounts.**
* **Hands-on experience with Home Depot Supplier Hub and Askuity required.**
* Strong understanding of Home Depot.com ecommerce operations, reporting, and account management.
* Experience with Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central.
* Experience managing a significant ecommerce account with multiple SKUs.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce sales, operational, and profitability KPIs.
* Advanced Excel and reporting skills.
* Experience with inventory forecasting and replenishment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and take ownership of issues through resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* Direct experience managing **Home Depot.com as a vendor or supplier**.
* Experience with both **Home Depot.com and Amazon**.
* Experience with Home Depot Supplier Hub, Askuity, and other Home Depot reporting systems.
* Amazon FBA experience.
* Consumer products, outdoor products, lighting, home improvement, or durable goods.
* Experience working with external Amazon advertising agencies.
* Experience managing 100+ SKUs.
* Knowledge of ecommerce SEO, conversion optimization, and retail media.
* Experience with TACoS, ACOS, ROAS, CPC, and other marketplace advertising metrics.

Pay: $72,000.00 - $108,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Norcross, GA 30071

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
Porter Logistics started in 2017 with two founders, one 3,000-square-foot warehouse and no customers. We won our first accounts one at a time by taking on the work other warehouses turned down and doing the work better than our clients expected.  
  
Today Porter runs four facilities across Atlanta and the Savannah port area. We handle the hard stuff: hazardous and specialty chemicals, food-grade and temperature-controlled freight from ambient to frozen, bonded imports and bulk chemical repackaging. Our customers include Fortune 500 manufacturers and global distributors in chemicals, food and beverage, consumer goods and building materials. They have their pick of 3PLs. They choose us.  
  
We've grown every year since we opened, and 2026 is on pace for 40% growth. Growth means new sites, new roles and room to move up. Many of our leaders started in entry-level roles here.  
  
**The Role**  
As a Customer Sucecss Representative, you'll be the first call for our clients and the source of clean, accurate orders for our warehouse team. Each day you'll enter client orders into our WMS, build pick lists and shipping documents, update the warehouse team on changes and priorities, close completed orders and bill each shipment. When an order, inventory count or shipment goes wrong, you'll track down the cause and work with the warehouse to fix the problem.  
  
This is a full-time hourly position based on-site at our Atlanta warehouse.  
  
**What You'll Earn**

* 20-22/hour based on experience
* Medical, dental and vision plans
* 401(k)
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Occasional overtime opportunities

**Schedule**

* Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM

  
**You'll Thrive Here If You**

* Catch a wrong SKU or quantity before an order reaches the floor
* Like owning a short list of clients and knowing every detail of their accounts
* Stay calm and clear when a client calls about a late shipment
* Want to grow with a company adding new sites and new clients

  
**This Might Not Be For You If**

* You prefer one task at a time. You'll manage orders for 3 to 5 clients at once.
* You'd rather pass a problem along than own the fix
* You want a role with no accountability for billing errors

  
**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Serve as the main point of contact for 3 to 5 client accounts.
* Enter daily client orders into the WMS accurately.
* Share order details, changes and priorities with the warehouse team.
* Generate pick lists, order packets and outbound shipping documents.
* Investigate and resolve order, inventory and fulfillment issues.
* Close out completed orders in the WMS.
* Bill shipments to the correct client accounts.

  
**What We're Looking For**

* 1+ year in customer service, operations support or a similar role requiring strong attention to detail, organization and customer service skills
* Clear, professional phone and email communication
* Strong organization across several accounts at once
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Word
* WMS experience preferred, not required
* Logistics, warehousing or supply chain experience preferred, not required

  
**The Hiring Process**  
We respect your time. If your background fits, a member of our HR team will call you for a short phone screen. Next, you'll visit the warehouse for an in-person interview, meet the team and tour the facility.

jobs.description:
**Position: Sales Development Representative**

**Location: United States, Remote**

*This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.*

**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we'd love to meet you.

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**

Be the first conversation that shows our future customers what Salesloft can do for them.

As our Inbound Sales Development Representative, you'll be the first human voice for people wanting to learn more about Salesloft. You'll work to understand who they are, what they care about, and what they're trying to achieve before connecting them with the right sales member. This is a role built to be a way in the door to a career in revenue at Salesloft. In your first six months you will:

* Respond to inbound interest quickly and with relevance, using signals and context rather than a generic script
* Run discovery conversations that qualify real needs and book high-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Build a working command of our story, our product, and our customers' world, and use Salesloft the way our customers do, so you can speak with credibility about it

**HOW YOU'LL WORK HERE** *(our values, in this role)*

* **Move as One:** You'll work daily with AEs, Marketing, and SDR peers, handing off cleanly and sharing credit for the wins you help create.
* **Evidence over Ego:** You'll let your experience and every day results drive your actions in the future - better meetings, better pitch, better experience.
* **Lead from the Front:** You'll take ownership early, whether it's a better handoff, a sharper question, or helping the next SDR ramp, with or without a title that says you should.
* **Make Your Mark:** You'll give feedback on messaging, routing, and process, and help shape how we engage inbound demand, not just run the playbook.
* **Customer-Inspired:** You'll turn what prospects tell you into insights that inform what Marketing, Sales, and Product build and say.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**  
You're curious, coachable, and energized by conversations with people you've never met. You're early in your career, or changing into it, and you want a structured place to learn how B2B revenue teams work. For this job, customer-centric mentality, attention to detail, and process-orientation mean more than direct sales experience. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

**YOU'LL BRING**

* A track record of clear, confident communication in writing and conversation (work, school, volunteering, or customer-facing roles all count)
* Evidence that you take feedback and improve quickly, with a specific example of something you got better at
* Comfort learning new tools and technical concepts and explaining them simply
* Organization and follow-through when juggling many conversations and tasks at once
* Genuine interest in a career in sales or revenue, and openness to a 1-2 year path in this role before moving on to your next step

**IT'S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE**

* Experience in customer-facing, service, or sales-adjacent work
* Familiarity with a CRM or sales engagement tool (Salesloft, ideally)
* Exposure to B2B software or SaaS
* Experience working toward goals or metrics in a team setting

**THE TEAM**

Our SDR team reports into the marketing organization, but you'll work alongside Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. You'll be learning from all sides of the business, while getting hands-on experience with our customers and prospects. You'll be trained with our solutions and will use them daily. Your immediate team is all US based, so it's easy to collaborate and ask questions. While the job is individual in nature when it comes to goals, you'll have support from a fellow SDR, a manager that's been at Salesloft for 4+ years, and confidence knowing that this role has only been opened due to an internal promotion. This is a great entry point to get into Salesloft.

*Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview at* *https://salesloftbenefits.com/*

*At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.*

*We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

*If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!*

jobs.title: Sales Representative (Georgia)
jobs.description:
**What is Exoticca?**

Exoticca is a pioneering online travel agency that has revolutionized the conception, production, and e-commerce of long-distance dream trips. At the core of Exoticca's brand equity is the commitment to "creating life milestones." We believe in delivering best-value trips, exploring unique destinations, curating extraordinary travel experiences, and demonstrating genuine care for both our customers and the planet.  
  
We are a professional, dynamic, multicultural team in rapid international growth, seeking new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of our generation.

**What do we do?**

Our B2B Sales Team is responsible for developing and growing Exoticca's network of Travel Advisors and agency partners across North America. Through a combination of field sales, training, account activation and relationship management, the team helps Travel Advisors discover Exoticca, understand our product and ultimately grow their business with us.

**What will you do?**  
The Sales Representative (B2B) is a field-based sales role focused on developing and growing Exoticca's Tier 2 and Tier 3 agency accounts (Silver & Bronze) within an assigned territory. This is a hands-on, execution-focused position with a strong emphasis on in-person agency visits, account activation and high-frequency market coverage.

You will work closely with the Business Development Managers and the broader B2B Sales Team to ensure that our Silver and Bronze accounts receive regular commercial attention, product education and support, helping them increase their engagement and bookings with Exoticca.

**Your main responsibilities will include:**  

* Visit Travel Agencies regularly across the assigned territory, maintaining a consistent and high-frequency field presence.
* Manage and develop a portfolio primarily composed of Silver and Bronze account (Tier 2 & Tier 3) within Exoticca's Loyalty Program.
* Build strong relationships with Travel Advisors and agency teams, becoming their day-to-day commercial point of contact.
* Activate and grow existing accounts, helping Travel Advisors move from registration to first booking and from occasional to more frequent production.
* Identify opportunities to reactivate dormant and low-producing accounts.
* Educate Travel Advisors on Exoticca's destinations, products, promotions, booking tools and Loyalty Program.
* Conduct in-person product presentations, agency trainings and webinars.
* Identify potential new agency partners and support the acquisition and activation of new accounts.
* Promote group opportunities and identify potential group business within the assigned portfolio.
* Attend relevant trade shows, industry events, conferences and FAM trips when required.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date information on account activity, visits and commercial opportunities in CRM.
* Work closely with Business Development Managers to identify accounts with significant growth potential that may require additional commercial support.
* Meet agreed activity and performance KPIs, including agency visits, account activation, booking activity and portfolio development.

The emphasis on frequent field coverage and a recurring visit pattern is intentional: the Sales Representative role is designed to provide more intensive market coverage than the more senior BDM structure.

 **Requirements**  

* 1–2 years of experience in sales, business development, account management on the travel industry.
* Experience within the travel industry is preferred, but we are also open to candidates with strong sales potential and a genuine interest in travel.
* Strong commercial mindset and enthusiasm for developing customer relationships.
* Comfortable spending a significant amount of time in the field visiting Trave Agencies.
* Self-motivated and comfortable managing a territory and daily visit schedule independently.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and presentation skills.
* Comfortable conducting small group presentations, product training and webinars.
* Organized and disciplined in managing follow-ups and CRM activity.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-changing and international environment.
* Willingness to learn, receive hands-on coaching and develop within the organization.
* Availability to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory and occasionally attend industry events and FAM trips.
* Fluency in Spanish is a plus.

  
**Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation package in line with job responsibilities and experience.
* Travel packages at reduced prices!
* English/Spanish lesson, bi-annual company parties.
* Referral bonus, if you bring people as talented as you.
* And last but not least, becoming part of a fun and motivated multicultural team at an agile and rapid growing organization!

Join Exoticca and play a pivotal role in creating life milestones through unforgettable travel experiences! This is your opportunity to shape the future of a dynamic and innovative travel brand on a global scale.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.description:
**About Climb**
===============

Climb is an AI-native Data & AI consultancy and Databricks partner. We help healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance companies get data and AI projects out of pilot and into production. Instead of large consulting teams, we staff small, senior engineering pods on fixed-scope engagements that reach production in 8 to 12 weeks.

We build long-term partnerships with the data teams we work with, and we grow our people the same way: through direct mentorship from founders and senior architects and real exposure to enterprise deals from day one.

**Role Summary**
================

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to open new accounts for Climb across regulated industries. You'll research companies running on Databricks or evaluating it, find the business problems their data teams are stuck on, and start conversations with the people who own them. You'll pair directly with a senior member of Climb’s GTM team and work alongside our solution architects and Databricks account teams on every pursuit, and you'll see how enterprise consulting deals are scoped and won.

We don't have a big-brand inbound engine. Every meeting we book comes from someone who found the right account, figured out who owned the problem, and started a real conversation.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Drive new-logo acquisition across healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance accounts.
* Build and manage pipeline through outbound prospecting across phone, email and LinkedIn, plus referrals and industry events.
* Plan and run account-based campaigns into named target accounts, coordinated with marketing and your Databricks counterparts.
* Build relationships across data, IT, compliance and executive leadership, and understand who decides what.
* Identify business challenges and translate them into data, analytics and AI opportunities our architects can scope.
* Run discovery on early-stage opportunities and co-run deals alongside your sales partner.
* Co-sell with Databricks account teams on shared accounts in your territory, and run a recurring sync with your assigned Databricks account executives and partner managers.
* Collaborate with solution architects and delivery leads to shape winning pursuits.
* Travel to represent Climb at client meetings, Databricks events, industry forums and Climb-hosted workshops.
* Track your activity and results, and help shape the playbook as we grow.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* **30 days:** You know our offerings and target accounts, and you've met your Databricks counterparts and set a recurring sync with each.
* **60 days:** You're booking qualified meetings you sourced yourself every week.
* **90 days:** You're consistently hitting your pipeline target and have contributed to at least one active opportunity.
* **6 months:** You're at full pipeline target, running discovery on your own, and co-running opportunities with your GTM partner.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 2+ years in a BDR or SDR seat, with a track record of meetings you sourced yourself, not just inbound follow-up.
* Experience selling to technical, IT or data buyers. Backgrounds in data infrastructure, cloud, developer tools or technical recruiting are a strong fit.
* Comfort with cold calling and hunting for contacts, and the ability to explain why you went after an account and why you started with the person you did.
* Ability to research accounts and understand buyer personas and decision-making structures.
* Curiosity about how data platforms and AI work, and the drive to learn the technology well enough to discuss it with an engineer.
* Strong client-facing presence and clear, concise writing.
* Bonus: Experience in or selling into healthcare, life sciences, financial services or insurance.

**Who Thrives Here**
====================

This role is designed for BDRs who build their own pipeline today and are growing toward owning accounts and closing deals.

* You'd rather build your own target list than wait for inbound leads.
* You know why you're calling an account, and who owns the problem, before you pick up the phone.
* You're curious about how data and AI work, and you're not shy about asking an engineer to explain it.
* You take rejection in stride and make the next call just as sharp.

**Why Climb**
=============

* **Learn from the builders.** Work directly with founders and senior architects from your first week.
* **Room to grow.** A clear path to Account Executive, with a promotion review at 12 months tied to sourced pipeline and conversion.
* **Where enterprise AI happens.** A front-row view of the Databricks ecosystem and enterprise AI work.
* **Ground floor opportunity.** Join early alongside seasoned founders to help construct our growth playbook from day one.
* **Focus on outcomes.** We measure success by tangible business value and account expansion rather than arbitrary utilization metrics.
* **Senior engineering pods.** Work directly with elite technical teams and AI tooling, free from management bloat.
* **Compounding IP.** Every enterprise win builds reusable assets and technical blueprints back into our firm.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive base plus uncapped variable
* MacBook Pro and swag kit so you can do your best work
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Generous holidays and flexible PTO
* 401(k) with company match
* Professional development budget including Databricks and cloud certifications
* Spot bonuses for relevant certifications
* Conference attendance and thought leadership opportunities
* Collaborative, low-ego culture with direct access to leadership
* Opportunity to shape a growing practice from the ground floor

Climb is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicant

**About Overwatch Mission Critical**

Overwatch is a service-disabled Veteran-owned small business (SDVOB) certified through the National Veterans Business Development Council (NVBDC), offering construction professional services, talent acquisition, and general contractor services for the mission-critical infrastructure industry.

Our mission is the construction and management of state-of-the-art data centers with the precision and reliability this industry demands. From high-end engineers to seasoned professionals, we deploy the people you need to get your data center off the ground. At Overwatch, it's more than a job. It's a purpose.

**Overview**

Office-based **Assistant Project Manager** supporting the team Atlanta-area construction. This is a junior-to-mid construction process and document-control role, not a senior field PM. The **Assistant Project Manager** keeps current, accurate information flowing among the GC, consultants, design partners, and internal stakeholders.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Own RFIs and submittals from log-in through follow-up and closeout.
* Maintain drawing revisions, field bulletins, specifications, meeting minutes, action items, and technical project correspondence.
* Ensure the GC receives the correct and current project information.

**Project Controls Support**

* Support cost reports, budget-versus-actual tracking, change-order logs, pay applications, schedule updates, look-aheads, and early identification of cost or schedule risks.
* These duties support the role but do not replace the primary focus on construction documentation and follow-through.

**Coordination**

* Coordinate directly with the GC, consultants, subcontractors, design teams, and the team stakeholders.
* Attend meetings, document decisions, issue clear follow-ups, and drive open items to resolution.

**Working Style**

* Task-oriented, reliable, accountable, and execution-first. Strong self-management and follow-up skills.
* Comfortable in a support role, willing to put in extra effort when needed, and able to communicate directly and honestly

**Driver’s License Requirement**

For roles that require on-site presence or travel between work locations as an essential function of the position, candidates must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license appropriate for the role and be eligible to operate a motor vehicle in accordance with applicable laws.

**Communication Skills**

Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively in a professional work environment, including preparing written reports and documentation, conveying information clearly to team members, clients, and stakeholders, and responding appropriately to verbal and written communications related to job duties.

**Physical Requirements and Work Environment**

This position operates primarily in an active data center construction environment, encompassing both indoor and outdoor work settings. The role requires the physical ability to perform essential job functions safely and effectively in a dynamic environment that includes ongoing construction activity and evolving site conditions.

The work environment includes areas and temporary structures owned, leased, or controlled by third parties over which Overwatch may have limited or no control. Because the project remains under construction, certain areas of the site — including access routes, staging zones, and temporary structures — may not yet be fully ADA-compliant until construction is complete or those third-party areas are finalized.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to walk, stand, stoop, twist, bend, and climb stairs or ladders for extended periods while navigating uneven, unpaved, or obstructed terrain.
* Must be able to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 50 pounds on an occasional basis.
* Must be able to drive between job sites and access all areas of an active construction zone, including raised platforms, scaffolding, and confined spaces.
* Must be able to tolerate exposure to outdoor weather conditions, dust, and construction-related noise, vibrations, and odors.
* Must be able to communicate effectively with contractors, engineers, and site personnel, and maintain situational awareness in high-activity environments.
* Personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hats, safety vests, hearing protection, and steel-toe boots, is required.
* Must have sufficient visual acuity to read drawings, specifications, and safety signage, and to observe site activity.

**Work Environment:**

Work is performed primarily in and around active construction areas, which may include unfinished buildings, temporary field offices, staging areas, and partially completed infrastructure. These locations may contain uneven surfaces, limited accessibility, and other conditions typical of construction projects prior to final completion. Overwatch does not control and cannot modify accessibility conditions within areas, facilities, or temporary structures owned or managed by third parties.

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position, provided such accommodations do not create safety hazards, impede essential mobility within active work zones, or require modification of facilities not owned or controlled by Overwatch.

**Benefits**

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, including health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid time off. Relocation assistance is available to support candidates transitioning to the location.

OVERWATCH is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. OVERWATCH considers candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Description:

$26hr for 15-20 hours a week for 40 weeks

Job Duties and Responsibilities

**General Job Description**

The MCMF Mentor Coach is primarily responsible for providing mentorship, guidance, coaching, and direct support to youth ages 16–24 employed through the My CHI My Future Program in partnership with the Chicago Department of Family and Support Services (DFSS).

The Mentor Coach will provide direct services to a caseload of 15 youth over a pre-scheduled 40-week program period, with a required commitment of 800 hours annually, in accordance with the funder-approved program schedule. This position is responsible for supporting youth employment, professional development, participant engagement, payroll administration, program compliance, and the planning and implementation of youth-led community events.

Major Duties and Responsibilities

**Youth Recruitment, Employment & Retention**

* Recruit, screen, and facilitate the hiring of 15 youth from the Brighton Park community.
* Maintain consistent communication with youth to support recruitment, engagement, and retention throughout the program.
* Provide ongoing mentorship, coaching, guidance, and advocacy to assigned youth participants.
* Develop and maintain positive relationships with youth, community partners, and partner site leads.
* Communicate program expectations, policies, procedures, and employment requirements to all participants.
* Follow up with youth who demonstrate inconsistent attendance or disengagement to address barriers and encourage continued participation.

**Employability Skills Training and Career Development**

* Facilitates individual and group-based workshops designed to strengthen participants' employment readiness and professional development.
* Provides training in workplace behaviors, communication, professionalism, financial literacy, digital literacy, career exploration, and other essential employability skills.
* Registers youth for upcoming job readiness workshops, training opportunities, and career development activities.
* Facilitates employability skills training that prepares youth for successful entry into the workforce and long-term career advancement.

**Community Events & Safe Space Engagement**

* Collaborate with program youth to plan, coordinate, and implement nine (9) community events throughout the program year, in accordance with the funder's established timeline.
* Ensure all nine events take place within the Brighton Park community and provide safe, welcoming, and engaging spaces for youth and community members.
* Develop events that offer fun, recreational, and educational activities while connecting attendees to valuable community resources and services.
* Coordinate event logistics, including food and beverage arrangements, giveaways, community resources, vendors, supplies, and activities.
* Encourage youth leadership and active participation in the planning, coordination, and implementation of each event.
* Ensure participant surveys are distributed and completed by youth attendees to collect feedback, measure engagement, and document program outcomes.
* Monitor survey completion and maintain accurate documentation to ensure all funder-required event deliverables and reporting requirements are met.
* Ensure each event aligns with program objectives, funder expectations, and the overall goal of creating safe spaces and strengthening community engagement.
* Identify, recruit, and engage community-based organizations, service providers, and local partners to participate in community kickback events.
* Coordinate with community partners to secure resource tables and informational materials that connect youth and community members to valuable resources, services, and support.
* Maintain positive relationships with community partners to encourage ongoing collaboration and participation in program events.
* Ensure participating partners provide relevant resources and information that address the needs and interests of youth and families in the Brighton Park community.

**Payroll, Administrative Responsibilities, and Reporting**

* Coordinate and process payroll for the 15 youth participants.
* Track, review, manage, and verify the accuracy of youth timesheets prior to payroll approval.
* Enter and maintain accurate youth attendance and timesheet records in the Cityspan system.
* Monitor the completion and submission of all required youth enrollment, employment, and program documentation.
* Ensure youth are registered and connected to the My CHI My Future (MCMF) platform.
* Maintain accurate participant records and complete all required program documentation and reporting.
* Completes and maintains accurate participant records, case notes, assessments, and required program documentation.
* Prepares and submits required reports, data, and documentation to SGA leadership in accordance with established timelines and program requirements.
* Ensures participant files and placement documentation are complete, accurate, and maintained in compliance with program and funder requirements.

**Program Implementation & Youth Development**

* Ensure all required program training, curricula, evaluations.
* Other Duties as assigned by SGA Management

Requirements:

**Education**

* High School Degree Required
* Associates in Human Services, Education, Psychology, Social Work or a related field preferred

**Experience**

* Experience working with young adults 16-24 years of age, preferred.
* Evening and weekend availability required.
* Fluency in English and Spanish required.
* Ability to travel between program locations, community sites, employer partners, training providers, and other program-related locations as needed.
* Experience facilitating group workshops, training sessions, or educational programming preferred.

**CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT**

* Evening and weekend availability required.
* Must have a valid driver’s license and automobile insurance required for work-related travel.

SUMMARY:
--------

The Administrative Coordinator provides administrative support for financial operations, the executive team, and human resources administration at Tree House Humane Society. This role is well-suited to a detail-oriented self-starter who is eager to learn and grow across multiple functional areas.

The Administrative Coordinator oversees day-to-day administrative workflows, exercises independent judgment to troubleshoot and resolve issues as they arise, and uses modern workplace technology, including approved artificial intelligence tools, to make administrative work more efficient, consistent, accessible and impactful.

This role supports basic financial operations and reporting, provides executive support, including meeting preparation, event scheduling, and logistics, and supports HR administrative functions such as recruiting and onboarding coordination and personnel file administration. The Administrative Coordinator is also expected to identify repetitive or inefficient administrative processes and, with appropriate guidance and oversight, improve them using existing technology, AI-assisted tools, templates, automation, and standardized workflows rather than recreating processes manually.

The Administrative Coordinator reports to the Director, Technology & Administration, and receives HR-related work direction from the Director, People & Culture, and administrative requests from the CEO. This is an in-person position at the Tree House shelter.

----------------------------

**Financial Operations**

### **Executive & Organizational Administration**

* Provide general administrative support to the Director, Technology & Administration, and other organizational leaders as assigned.
* Identify recurring administrative needs and recommend opportunities to simplify, standardize, or improve related workflows.

**Administrative and Tech Support**

* Coordinate technology-related onboarding and offboarding logistics, including equipment preparation, account provisioning requests, and tracking completion.
* Coordinate shared organizational resources, including office equipment, meeting technology, shared devices, and mailing systems.
* Analyze recurring office, workspace, or administrative issues and recommend process improvements to relevant supervisors.
* Look for opportunities to reduce repetitive administrative work through better use of existing systems, integrations, forms, templates, automation, and approved AI-assisted tools.
* Drive to local locations to drop off or pick up organizational materials, equipment, and supplies as needed.

**People Operations**

* Support recruiting and onboarding administration, including scheduling interviews, coordinating candidate communication, and preparing onboarding materials and new employee access.
* Maintain personnel files and HR documentation in accordance with organizational policy and applicable recordkeeping requirements.
* Support HR data entry and administrative tasks within ADP and other HR systems as directed by the Director, People & Culture.
* Administers payroll and timecard review processes.
* Maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion when handling sensitive personnel and financial information.
* Use AI and other technology responsibly and in accordance with Tree House policies regarding privacy, confidentiality, data security, records management, and responsible AI use.

### Professional Qualifications

* Demonstrated experience in an administrative, coordinator, or support role.
* Ability to learn financial administration processes and systems with training and support.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator 2
jobs.description:
**Department**

BSD CCC - Network Oncology Research Support

**About the Department**

The University of Chicago Comprehensive Cancer Center (UCCCC) is an integral component of the Biological Sciences Division (BSD). The BSD is the largest of four Divisions of the University and includes the Pritzker School of Medicine. UCCCC administers four established scientific programs, and the NCI-sponsored Cancer Center Support Grant funds ten Shared Resources. The Comprehensive Cancer Center comprises over 190 faculty members from twenty departments, with members currently being awarded over $47 million in total direct costs in peer-reviewed cancer research grants, and $28 million in non-peer-reviewed grants and contracts. The activities of the Center are broad and varied, including research, training and education, communications, fundraising, marketing, clinical trials management, and community outreach.  
  
UCCCC has one of the largest cancer clinical trials programs in the country and in the Chicago area, with nearly 500 adult and pediatric therapeutic trials actively accruing patients. Many of these studies are investigator-initiated, including Phase I or I/II trials, demonstrating UCCCC's commitment to translating basic research findings to the clinic through proof-of-principle and early-phase studies. UCCCC opens over 250 new trials each year and accrues approximately 900 participants to therapeutic trials each year.

**Job Summary**

The Clinical Research Coordinator 2 (CRC2) is a specialized researcher partnering with the clinical Principal Investigator (PI) and under the direction of a departmental or lab research manager. While the Principal Investigator is primarily responsible for the overall design, conduct, and management of the clinical trial, the CRC2 supports, facilitates and coordinates independently the daily clinical trial activities and plays a critical role in the conduct of the study. By performing these duties with limited supervision and/or guidance, the CRC2 works with the PI, department, sponsor, and institution to support and provide guidance on the administration of the compliance, financial, personnel and other related aspects of the clinical study.

**Responsibilities**

* Manages all aspects of conducting clinical trials including screening, enrollment, subject follow-up, completion of the case report form, and adverse event reports.
* Recruits and interviews potential study patients with guidance from PI and other clinical research staff.
* Collects, processes, ships and stores specimens to appropriate laboratory according to established aseptic techniques.
* Identifies and explains the responsibilities of principal investigators, research team members, sponsors, contract research organizations (CROs), and regulatory authorities related to the conduct of a clinical trial.
* Coordinates the conduct of the study from startup through closeout including recruitment and screening of study subjects, obtaining informed consent, collecting research data, and ensuring protocol adherence.
* Plans and coordinates patient schedule for study procedures, return visits, and study treatment schedules.
* Educates patients about study procedures to be performed, visit schedule, what to report between and during visits, and the risks and benefits of the procedures.
* Performs assessments at visits and monitors for adverse events.
* Organizes and attends site visits from sponsors and other relevant study meetings.
* Protects patients and data confidentiality by ensuring security of research data and personal health information and compliance with federal regulations and sponsor protocols.
* Ensures Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) are implemented and documented in accordance to study sponsor, primary investigator, and regulatory agency specifications.
* Maintains accurate and complete records which may include, but are not limited to, signed informed consent, relevant IRB approvals, source documentation, Case Report Forms (CRF's), drug dispensing logs, and study related communication.
* Understands the IRB submission and review process and when and how to apply for IRB review, including facilitation of study initiation through meticulous and timely preparation of IRB submissions independently.
* Ensures compliance with federal regulations and institutional policies.
* May prepare and maintain protocol submissions and revisions.
* May assist in the training of new or backup coordinators.
* Assists with various professional, organizational, and operational tasks under moderate supervision.
* Facilitates and participates in the daily activities of moderately complex clinical studies and performs various activities including patient data retrieval, documenting clinical research records, and participation in program audits.
* Uses knowledge of clinical studies to coordinate the collection of analyzable clinical research data and/or sampleswith a limited to moderate degree of independence. Contributes to the problem solving on assigned clinical research studies and tasks.
* Performs other related work as needed.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education:**

Minimum requirements include a college or university degree in related field.

**Work Experience:**

Minimum requirements include knowledge and skills developed through 2-5 years of work experience in a related job discipline.

**Certifications:**

**-**

* Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and effectively with patients, faculty, staff, research teams, sponsors, and other stakeholders.
