jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer-facing work actually succeed.

Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous accolades, including a **Certified Great Place to Work in 2026,** **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**.

As an Account Manager at Front, you will own the commercial health and growth of a portfolio of customers. This is a relationship-driven role where you’ll manage renewals, uncover expansion opportunities, and help customers get more value from Front over time.

You’ll partner closely with a dedicated Customer Success Manager (CSM). While the CSM focuses on product adoption and value realization, you will own the commercial relationship—building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, navigating complex opportunities, and delivering predictable revenue outcomes. This role is a great fit for someone who combines commercial acumen, customer empathy, and operational rigor.

**What will you be doing?**

* **Own the commercial lifecycle:** Manage renewals and expansion opportunities across a portfolio of core customers, from early planning through negotiation and close.
* **Drive revenue growth:** Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, run thoughtful discovery, build business cases, negotiate contracts, and close commercial deals.
* **Build trusted customer relationships:** Develop strong relationships with customer stakeholders and understand their goals, challenges, and evolving business needs.
* Position Front’s broader value: Introduce AI capabilities like Autopilot, Professional Services, premium support, and other relevant offerings to help customers automate workflows, accelerate time-to-value, and expand their use of Front.
* **Partner with Customer Success:** Collaborate closely with your mapped CSM to use product usage data, health signals, and customer feedback to drive expansion and mitigate churn risk.
* **Lead strategic account planning:** Create and execute account plans that align customer priorities with Front’s capabilities and identify paths to long-term growth.
* **Maintain operational excellence:** Keep accurate CRM records, manage pipeline, forecast renewals and expansion, and consistently track customer and commercial activity.
* **Collaborate cross-functionally:** Partner with Sales, Support, Product, Marketing, and Services to resolve issues, advocate for customer feedback, and improve the customer experience.

**What skills and experience do you need?**

* **Experience:** 3–5 years in Account Management, Customer Success, or a related commercial role, ideally managing and growing a portfolio of SaaS customers.

**Remote-first with regular time in our partners' Chicago offices**

**The role in one sentence**
----------------------------

**You'll be Let's Do This's person on the ground in Chicago: embedded with a World Marathon Major, trusted by its team as one of their own, and accountable for making our technology move their business forward this year and for years to come.**

**About the role**
------------------

**Our US business is growing fast, and Chicago is at the heart of it. We're looking for a Key Account Manager to own our relationship with the Chicago-based organizer of a World Marathon Major and its year-round event portfolio, alongside a small number of other strategic US partners.**

**This isn't an account you manage from a dashboard. You'll spend real time in our partner's offices, at their planning meetings and on their start lines. You'll learn their mission, their values and the pressures behind every decision, well enough to anticipate what they need before they ask. Then you'll bring that understanding back into Let's Do This, so our product, our people and our AI tools are pointed at what matters most to them.**

**You'll be the partner's voice inside LDT and LDT's voice inside the partner. Holding both, credibly and at the same time, is the job.**

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**In your first 90 days**

* **You know the partner's team, goals, calendar and pain points as well as anyone at LDT**
* **You've built a joint account plan with their leadership covering the year ahead**
* **You've become the first call for their team, with faster answers and fewer escalations**

**In your first 12 months**

* **You've led the partner through a full event cycle, from registration open to race day and the debrief after**
* **Revenue, renewal readiness and account health across your portfolio are up and to the right**
* **At least one manual workflow at each partner has been replaced with an AI-enabled one**
* **Partners describe LDT as a strategic partner, not a vendor, and would recommend us to their peers**

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Embed with our flagship Chicago partner**

* **Spend regular time onsite with the partner's team, so you're part of how they plan, operate and make decisions**
* **Understand their mission and values deeply, and represent them faithfully inside LDT**
* **Build trusted relationships at every level, from day-to-day operations to senior leadership**
* **Anticipate needs across their event calendar, not just their biggest weekend**

### **Own commercial performance and retention**

* **Own revenue performance, retention and renewals across your portfolio**
* **Build and drive multi-quarter account strategies tied to each partner's goals**
* **Keep account health strong and renewal readiness high, flagging risk early and clearly**
* **Find and land growth opportunities that measurably improve partner performance**

* **Translate the partner's strategic goals into how LDT's platform, integrations and data should work for them**
* **Act as a technical advisor on registration, participant experience, data flows and integrations**
* **Turn partner needs into clear, prioritized product insight, and partner with Product to shape the roadmap**
* **Make sure partners adopt and get full value from new features, including our AI-powered products and agents**

### **Work AI-first**

* **Use LDT's internal AI tools, alongside external tools, to generate insights, prioritize actions and scale your impact**
* **Deliver data-driven recommendations on performance trends, conversion and operational efficiency**
* **Help partners move from manual, LDT-supported workflows to AI-enabled, self-sufficient ones**
* **Ask "how do I 10x my impact with AI?" rather than "how do I do more manually?"**

### **Show up when it matters**

* **Be onsite for race week and race weekends, supporting partners at their most critical moments**

**About you**
-------------

* **Comfortable in ambiguity, and good at building structure where there isn't any**

**Bonus points**

* **Experience in endurance events, mass-participation sport, live events or ticketing**

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Arrive Logistics is a leading transportation and technology company in North America with plans to grow significantly year over year. Our success is a testament to our remarkable team and what we’re building together. **Who We Want**

First, someone who is passionate about building and scaling a new and growing vertical within Arrive. As a Manager of Client Success at Arrive, **with a dedicated focus on the Arrive Fresh/produce vertical,** you will take a leadership position managing our produce shippers. You will be responsible for the performance and operational strategy of a Client Success team specializing in fresh and perishable goods. This role involves collaborating closely with other department leaders to optimize business processes and drive strategic initiatives specifically within the produce supply chain. This position requires a leader who can navigate the unique challenges of produce freight, champion necessary changes, lead by example, and work cross-functionally to ensure the success of Arrive’s objectives in this critical sector. This Client Success Manager will be instrumental in shaping our Arrive Fresh Client Success strategy and fostering a culture of excellence and collaboration within this specialized area.

The Client Success Manager for Arrive Fresh acts as the main point of contact for fresh-produce shippers, growers, receivers and carriers. Because produce freight is time-sensitive and temperature-controlled (refrigerated/reefer), you and your team will monitor shipments, coordinate with carriers, manage cold-chain expectations, and prevent transit issues before they impact the client's bottom line.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Account Ownership:** Serve as the primary trusted advisor and daily point of contact for a portfolio of produce freight clients.
* **Shipment & Cold-Chain Tracking:** Monitor reefer (refrigerated) loads in transit, track temperature logs, and coordinate proactively with dispatchers and carriers to prevent delays or spoilage.
* **Issue & Exception Management:** Rapidly resolve delivery disruptions, temperature deviations, detention issues, or claims in collaboration with operations and claims teams.
* **Manage and Coach:** Coach a team of Client Success Reps to understand the knowledge and service skills required to perform at a high level for Produce Customers.
* **Client Onboarding:** Guide new produce shippers or receivers through platform/system setup, tender processes, and communication protocols.
* **Performance Reviews:** Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) analyzing on-time delivery (OTD) rates, and tender acceptance.
* **Retention & Growth:** Drive account retention, handle renewals, and identify opportunities to expand freight volume or cross-sell specialized logistics services.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with sales, carrier procurement, and accounting teams to align service levels and resolve billing or rate discrepancies.

### **Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or operations within freight brokerage, third-party logistics (33L/3PL), or supply chain management.
* **Industry Knowledge:** Familiarity with reefer freight, temperature-controlled transport, produce seasonality, or USDA/FDA food-transit standards is a strong plus.
* Proficiency in Transportation Management Systems (TMS), CRM software (e.g., Salesforce), and data analytics or spreadsheet tools.
* Exceptional communication, high-pressure problem-solving, active listening, and composure during time-critical crisis management.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent operational experience).

### **The Perks of Working With Us**

* Take advantage of our comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental coverage.
* Invest in your future with our matching 401(k) program.
* Build relationships and take part in learning opportunities through our Employee Resource Groups.
* Enjoy office wide engagement activities, team events, happy hours and more!
* Leave the suit and tie at home; our dress code is casual.
* Work in the heart of downtown Chicago, IL!
* Sweat it out at the LifeStart gym in our office building that includes brand new Peloton bikes, top-of-the-line equipment and personal training options.
* Maximize your wellness with free counseling sessions through our Employee Assistance Program
* Take time to manage your physical and mental health - we offer company paid holidays, paid vacation time and wellness days.
* Receive 100% paid parental leave when you become a new parent.
* Get paid to work with your friends through our Referral Program!
* Get relocation assistance! If you are not local to the area, we offer relocation packages.

*The base salary range for this position is $95,000 - $120,000, plus bonus and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the pay range for the position across all locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on work location, job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training.*

**Your Arrive Experience**

When we say “award-winning culture,” we mean it. We’ve been recognized as a top workplace by Inc. Fast Company, Fortune, and earned Top Workplaces and Great Place to Work, to name a few. We intend on topping many more of those lists in the years to come, but we’re not in it for the trophies. jobs.description:
Healthcare Operations Coordinator

Neolytix | Chicago, IL (On-site) | Full-Time

About Neolytix

Neolytix is a healthcare management services organization supporting 270+ provider groups across revenue cycle management, credentialing & enrollment, patient access, and payer analytics. Our Chicago office is the US hub of a global delivery team spanning three countries.

The Role

You’ll be the operational backbone of our Chicago office — coordinating across provider enrollment, payer relations, and client service while keeping the day-to-day running smoothly. This is a high-touch role where you’ll work directly with company leadership and clients, so strong communication and a bias toward getting things done matter more than any single technical skill.

What You’ll Do

* Support provider enrollment and credentialing workflows, including follow-ups with payers, tracking application status, and resolving issues to keep timelines on track.
* Assist with payer contract communications — drafting correspondence, organizing documentation, and coordinating between internal teams and payer contacts.
* Serve as a point of contact for local clients, including scheduling check-ins, preparing meeting materials, and occasionally visiting client sites in the Chicagoland area.
* Handle office operations for our Chicago location: supplies, scheduling, travel coordination, expense tracking, employee coordination for US-based staff, and support for marketing events and industry conferences.
* Maintain organized records across enrollment cases, payer interactions, and client communications so nothing falls through the cracks.
* Prepare basic reports and dashboards to support team visibility into operational workflows (Power BI experience a plus; we’ll invest in building your skills here).

What We’re Looking For

* Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare administration, or a related field (MBA a plus).
* 1–3 years of experience in operations, client services, or administrative coordination — healthcare industry exposure preferred but not required.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; bilingual English/Spanish is a significant plus.
* Comfort working across multiple workstreams simultaneously in a small-team environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with Power BI or other reporting tools is a bonus.
* Reliable, self-directed, and comfortable operating with minimal supervision.

What We Offer

* Competitive hourly compensation commensurate with experience.
* Direct mentorship from senior leadership across healthcare operations, payer strategy, and analytics.
* A clear growth path — this role is designed to deepen into payer analytics and client strategy as you develop.
* A small, high-impact team where your contributions are visible from day one

Pay: $60,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you open to working onsite at our office located in Chicago, IL?
* Expected Salary (Hourly)
* Do you have 1–3 years of experience in Healthcare operations, Healthcare client services?

Work Location: In person

The Executive Assistant is a trusted partner to the CEO, responsible for managing the CEO’s time, priorities, communications, and logistics while also owning the day-to-day operation of L5’s Chicago office. This role combines high level executive support with hands-on office management and administrative coordination across the business. The ideal candidate anticipates needs before they arise, brings structure to competing demands, exercises sound judgment with highly confidential information, and takes ownership without needing constant direction. It is a highly cross-functional role, partnering closely with the executive leadership team, human resources, finance, operations, business development, and marketing as well as clients, partners, and board members.

Responsibilities:

**Executive Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and gatekeeper for the CEO, managing access and prioritizing requests from internal and external stakeholders.
* Proactively manage a complex, fast-moving calendar, resolving conflicts and protecting time for strategic priorities.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, including leadership team meetings, client and partner meetings, and board meetings; prepare agendas, briefing materials, and pre-reads, and track follow-up actions to completion.
* Draft, edit, and proofread correspondence, presentations, reports, and other materials on behalf of the CEO with a high standard of quality and professionalism.
* Plan and manage domestic travel, including itineraries, site visits to client facilities, conferences, and related logistics; adjust quickly when plans change.
* Process and reconcile the CEO’s expense reports accurately and on time.
* Handle confidential business, client, financial, and personnel information with the utmost discretion.
* Support special projects and executive initiatives, including research, tracking, and coordination across teams.

**Office Operations**

* Own the office environment, creating a welcoming, organized, and professional workplace for employees, clients, and visitors.
* Manage day-to-day office operations, including supplies, mail and deliveries, and general upkeep.
* Serve as the first point of contact for visitors, vendors, and office-related questions.
* Coordinate with building management, landlords, and vendors to resolve facilities issues.
* Plan and coordinate company meetings, leadership offsites, small client dinners, celebrations, and team-building activities, including vendors, logistics, and setup.

**Join us as we empower the world to work out, creating healthier lives together.**
===================================================================================

Life Fitness and Hammer Strength are building a live, always-on social presence rooted in real facilities, real users, and real training.

This is a hands-on creator role, not a scheduler role. We’re looking for someone who loves creating content, is genuinely passionate about fitness, can spot new trends, and is comfortable connecting with people to find and capture moments worth sharing.

You’ll work both behind and in front of the camera, creating content from gyms, customer facilities, events, and other real-world fitness environments across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.

You don’t need a large personal following. What matters is your ability to recognize a great idea, turn it into engaging content, and help create a distinctive social presence for Life Fitness and Hammer Strength.

**What You’ll Do**

* Concept, shoot, edit, and publish engaging short-form social content.
* Find content opportunities in gyms, customer facilities, events, trade shows, athlete shoots, and brand activations.
* Spot trends and cultural moments and turn them into authentic, platform-native content.
* Connect comfortably with members, exercisers, trainers, customers, athletes, and partners to capture real stories and moments.
* Work both behind and in front of the camera, depending on what makes the content stronger.
* Support day-to-day publishing and community engagement across social platforms.
* Use content performance and audience insights to test, learn, and improve.
* Collaborate with the broader marketing team to bring Life Fitness and Hammer Strength to life in ways that feel fresh, relevant, and authentic.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2–5 years of experience creating social content for a brand, agency, media company, or as a creator.
* A portfolio demonstrating strong short-form video work and hands-on experience concepting, filming, and editing.
* Strong creative instincts and an understanding of what makes social content engaging.
* Genuine enthusiasm for fitness, training, sport, or wellness.
* Confidence engaging with people in live environments and creating content in the moment.
* Comfortable both behind and in front of the camera.
* Strong working knowledge of TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and evolving social formats.
* Self-motivated, curious, and able to move quickly from idea to finished content.
* Ability to travel up to 20% domestically, with occasional international travel.

We’re more interested in the quality of your ideas and content than the size of your personal following. Show us work that demonstrates your creative instincts, point of view, and ability to tell stories people want to watch.

*This is a hybrid role based at our Global Headquarters in Rosemont, IL. Team members work remotely on Mondays and Fridays, with in-office collaboration Tuesday through Thursday. #LI-Hybrid*
